Description_A_Wrinkle_in_Time: This "science fantasy" adventure starts off the classic Time Quintet series where three young heroes travel through time and space and face matters of good and evil.

Description_Alias_Grace: In this narrativised version of a historical murder case, a young woman's crimes come into question when she is released from prison. Is Grace Marks really a killer? Find out in this lyrical Gothic novel.
Description_Alvar_Aalto: Get to know the Finnish design master Alvar Aalto, as this book takes us on a visual journey through almost sixty years of iconic creations, including photographs, plans, and sketches.

Description_Anathem: What happens when all of the planet's intellectuals are shut off from the rest of the world, left to ponder existence without ever experiencing it? Find out in this epic and ambitious sci-fi page-turner.
Description_Angels_&_Demons: The first in a series of thrilling mystery novels, Angels & Demons entails an elaborate assassination plot on high-ranking Vatican officials. But what did the mysterious Illuminati have to do with it all?
Description_Animal_Farm: The allegorical tale of anthropomorphic farm animals, who overthrow the farmer's rule over them and attempt to lead the farm themselves. It is one of the most important pieces of 20th-century political satire, asking: What happens after the revolution?
Description_Architecture_in_Britain;1530: From the Renaissance to Neoclassicism, this guide charts the development of English architectural theory and practice, alongside marvellous colour photographs by A.F. Kersting.

Description_As_Good_As_Dead: The finale to the Good Girl's Guide to Murder YA series and a catching mystery for any true crime podcast fans out there. Will our titular Good Girl make it out unscathed?
Description_At_the_Earth's_Core: The Hollow Earth sci-fi novel for anyone who read 1864's Journey to the Centre of the Earth and thought: "Not enough dinosaurs!"
Description_Attack_On_Titan;Volume_1: Eren Yeager has sworn to take revenge on the giant humanoid creatures known as Titans, who destroyed his home and killed his mother. An action-packed and thrilling first volume of the dystopian fantasy manga.
Description_Babel;or_the_Necessity_of_Vi: This novel explores an alternate-reality British Empire, in which languages and their meanings are harnessed for their immense magical power at Oxford University.
Description_Beloved: An unrivalled piece of gothic historical fiction by Toni Morrison, a master of magical realism. Beloved tells a story about the trauma of slavery and how past hurt can linger like a ghost.
Description_Better_Than_the_Movies: Liz is on a quest for a teen love story like in the movies. Can her annoying neighbour Wes really help her go to prom with her crush? And why does he have to be so attractive?
Description_Call_Me_by_Your_Name: Their age gap seems to be unable to deter Elio and Oliver from their obsession with each other, and they experience the highs and lows of a first gay romance. Delve into the poetic tragedy of an unforgettable summer in 1980s Italy.
Description_Cat's_Eye: Cat's Eye tells the tale of a woman's art, memory, and a childhood friendship gone awry. How can she come to terms with her past?
Description_Charlie_and_the_Chocolate_Fa: Only five lucky winners of a golden ticket will be allowed to discover the true goings-on in Willy Wonka's magical chocolate factory. Join them in this illustrated children's tale.
Description_Charlotte's_Web: When a clever spider and a radiant pig become friends, what could stand in their way? A charming children's classic with beautiful illustrations.
Description_Chemistry;The_Central_Scienc: An essential guide for all students looking to expand their knowledge of the sciences. This classic textbook contains all the essentials to begin understanding the squishiest of all sciences.
Description_Circe: You might know her story already, as Odysseus tells it. But in this modern retelling of Greek mythology, the tale of the sorceress on her island gains a whole new depth.
Description_Collected_Poems;1934-1952: One of the most important Welsh poets of the 20th century, Thomas' writing is lauded for its strong imagery and thought-provoking depths. Recommended reading for the seaside!
Description_Confess: As Auburn is trying to rebuild her life, she is instantly smitten with the mysterious artist Owen. But can their relationship last as his past is revealed? A suspenseful adult romance unfolds.
Description_Dark_Matter: A thrilling action plot unfolds when ordinary physics professor Jason is abducted and finds himself in a parallel world. What dark paths will he face to make it back to his old life?
Description_Dark_Places: Little Libby's life in rural Kansas is forever changed when she witnesses the murder of her family. Twenty-four years later, she revisits it all for the entertainment of crime-loving strangers.
Description_Death_Note;Volume_1: When the power over life and death falls into the hands of Light Yagami, the young student vows to use it for good. But death god Ryuk might have other plans.
Description_Death_on_the_Nile: Detective Poirot is keeping to the background on his Egyptian vacation to carefully observe the mystery unfolding before him. Everyone had a motive, but who is cold-blooded enough to be the killer?
Description_Divergent: In a post-apocalyptic Chicago, sixteen-year-old Tris is left with no choice but to join one of five factions. Prepare for an action-packed, dystopian story for young adult readers.
Description_Down_Under: An entertaining yet educational travelogue exploring a Sunburned Country, also known as Australia. Marvel about the country's people, history, landscape, flora and fauna.
Description_Dracula: A chilling classic that masterfully mixes the 19th-century epistolary novel with early gothic horror. It follows boring businessman Jonathan Harker on a trip to a certain Transylvanian castle...
Description_Dragonsong: Menolly can't stay in her fishing village, which forbids her dreams and confines her to rigid gender roles. Surprisingly, the new life awaiting her holds songs and dragons in store.
Description_Emma: In this comedy of manners from Austen, socialite Emma is very confident in her matchmaking skills. But when will she learn that not everyone appreciates her meddling?
Description_Fantastic_Mr_Fox: A clever fox and his family set out to outsmart their farming neighbours in this charmingly illustrated classic children's novel.
Description_Feminist,_Queer,_Crip: In this work, Professor Alison Kafer proposes a critical framework that imagines another future for disabled and queer bodies and rejects the idea of disability as a predetermined limit.
Description_Five_on_a_Treasure_Island: A childhood adventure with five friends, a shipwreck, and a hidden treasure. The first in the classic Famous Five series of children's mystery novels.
Description_Flower_Fables: A collection of fairy stories and poems, Flower Fables is a charming and delightful book, illustrated and easy to read for children and adults of any age.
Description_Flowers_for_Algernon: A science-fiction short story turned novel, which grapples with the meaning of intelligence, disability, and the consequences of human augmentation in the name of progress.
Description_Frog_and_Toad_Together: Oh, to garden, bike, and go on adventures with your soulmate! While these short stories might strictly qualify as children's literature, who doesn't yearn for the life of Frog and Toad?
Description_Full_Dark,_No_Stars: Four chilling and devastating novellas by Stephen King, dealing with the darkness of retribution and revenge. True horror, read with care!
Description_Games,_Game_Design,_Game_Stu: The must-read primer for anyone seeking to become a serious games scholar.
Description_Gone_Girl: Following the blossoming relationship of Nick and Amy, we flash forward to their fifth wedding anniversary, where Amy has suddenly disappeared... Has Nick become a man capable of killing his wife?
Description_Good_Girl,_Bad_Blood: Student investigator turned podcaster Pippa is trying to leave her detective days behind. But how can she ignore this recent disappearance, when the police won't even investigate?
Description_Good_Night,_Gorilla: When the zookeeper isn't looking, this little gorilla isn't the only animal who sneaks out of the zoo. A short and sweet bedtime story for the little ones.
Description_Gregor_the_Overlander: Gregor discovers a hidden world beneath New York City in this charming, yet dangerous fantasy adventure for young readers. Will he live up to the prophecy foretelling his deeds?
Description_Gulliver's_Travels: Through the various travels of Gulliver, this proto-science fiction novel satirises the political environment of England and the travelogues popular during its colonial expansions.
Description_Hamlet: This Danish prince suddenly has a lot going on. His father is dead, his uncle is evil, and his mother is quickly getting remarried... So, it is entirely understandable that Hamlet now plunges into a crisis.
Description_Heartstopper;Volume_1: The heartwarming graphic novel where Nick and Charlie meet at a grammar school for boys. Prepare to giggle and blush while watching sparks unfold between them!
Description_Heidi: The heartwarming story of little Heidi, who lives with her grandfather in the Swiss Alps, changing the lives of those around her for the better. A classic for children all around the world.
Description_Homage_to_Catalonia: An exceptionally observant, vivid, and often witty journalistic work turned memoir by George Orwell, wherein he tells of his time fighting fascists in the Spanish Civil War.
Description_Howl's_Moving_Castle: Sophie seeks out the mysterious wizard Howl, and his ever-moving castle, since he might be her only chance of breaking her enchantment. Is there more to his heartlessness than meets the eye?
Description_If_Not,_Winter;(Fragments_of: A collection of ancient fragments, this book offers a glimpse into the captivating poetry of a mysterious Greek writer whose verses of passion (for women) have stood the test of time.
Description_If_We_Were_Villains: Seven acting students at an elite arts college are very familiar with Shakespearean drama. But soon, the fictional power struggles and love entanglements they enact become their reality, too.
Description_In_Cold_Blood: Murder, mystery, and chilling psychology intertwine in this pioneering work in the true crime genre, as Capote (and his friend Harper Lee) extensively research a 1959 case.
Description_Inferno: The first part of the epic Divine Comedy, and the most famous work of self-insert bible fanfiction to date. Wherein Dante and Virgil delve deep through the nine circles of hell.
Description_The_Inheritance_Games: This thrilling mystery for young adults kicks off a series of novels surrounding Avery, a teenager who suddenly becomes heir to a strange billionaire's fortune. If she can make it that far...
Description_It: This one will certainly make you afraid of clowns, balloons and storm drains... if you aren't already. A staple of small-town horror fiction, It makes children's nightmares a reality.
Description_Italian_Villas_and_Their_Gar: Sixteen years before her famous novel, The Age of Innocence, Wharton publishes this scholarly travel book. It is a remarkably detailed survey of Italian garden architecture.
Description_James_and_the_Giant_Peach: This fantastical adventure follows James into a peachy realm populated by friendly worms and bugs. An illustrated book perfect for children.
Description_Journey_to_the_Centre_of_the: Have you always wanted to meet a dinosaur? Easy, just hop down an Icelandic volcano and check at the Earth's core. They should hopefully still be there. An early science fiction classic.
Description_Julius_Caesar: Who's up for a political assassination with the homies? Come on. It's for the good of Rome, right? — No! Wrong! — Beware this gruesome political tragedy, lest you get caught up in the stabbing, too.
Description_Kiki's_Delivery_Service: A spirited young witch needs to learn how to stand on her own two feet as she arrives in a bustling and charming seaside town. Sound familiar, anyone?
Description_Henry_V: Shakespeare's next Henry must prove his might in a war against France in this dramatic retelling of English history. And he's certainly nailing the speeches!
Description_Labyrinths: Labyrinths: Selected Stories & Other Writings is a representative selection of essays, short stories, and parables written by Argentine poet Borges and translated into English.
Description_Le_Corbusier: Known as a designer of brutalist buildings, this collection of his projects illustrates Le Corbusier's belief in better living conditions for the increasingly crowded cities of the 20th century.
Description_Little_Women: The four March sisters navigate love, loss, and the trials of growing up into womanhood, as their coming-of-age story reflects parts of Alcott's own youth.
Description_Love: This literary novel employs magical realism and non-linear storytelling to explore the relationship of Christine and Heed, two childhood friends who are now divided over the legacy of the deceased Bill Cosey.
Description_Macbeth:
Thanks to three witches' prophecy, Lady and Lord Macbeth begin to believe that they deserve a bigger piece of the cake. And they decide to make it everyone else's problem...
A murderous and cursed tragedy inspired by Scottish history. Don't say the name out loud!
Description_Meridian: The captivating story of Meridian Hill, a female activist in the Civil Rights Movement of the 1960s and 70s, and her political and personal revolutions in life.
Description_Middlemarch: A charming study of English provincial life, with all of its love, ambition, and scandal. Follow the lives of unforgettable characters in this literary classic.
Description_milk_and_honey: A poetic journey through heartbreak and healing and the hurt and love that come with 21st-century womanhood.
Description_Misery: An obsessive fan has no plans of ever letting her favourite romance author go... Another cocaine-fueled 80s horror classic.
Description_Moby-Dick: A maniacal pursuit, an enigmatic white giant, and a captain obsessed with vengeance. A commercial failure, and "the greatest book of the sea ever written", according to Walter.
Description_Momo;or,_The_Grey_Gentlemen: A strange story of time thieves and a curious child on a mission to return stolen time and joy to her town. Get inspired by this children's classic!
Description_Journey_to_the_West;or,_Monk: A mischievous shapeshifter embarks on a legendary adventure, based on folk tales and legends, in this timeless Chinese classic.
Description_Murder_on_the_Orient_Express: What better place to murder someone than on the world-famous Orient Express? Only the killer forgot that the genius detective Hercule Poirot is also on board.
Description_Night_Shift: No, not the Lucy Dacus song! It's a collection of spooky Stephen King short stories instead. Perfect for enthusiasts of 80s horror.
Description_Nimona: Shapeshifter Nimona's plan was to become the sidekick to newly-termed villain Ballister. But when the heroes are not as goodhearted as everyone believed, that plan might have to change last-minute...
Description_Nineteen_Eighty-Four: A classic of dystopian social science fiction, for good reason. Totalitarianism, mass surveillance, and state oppression of nonconformity - 1984 has got them all.
Description_Normal_People: Follow Connell and Marianne as they grow up in Ireland, fall in love, struggle at school, and navigate their socioeconomic differences in this young romance novel.
Description_Northanger_Abbey: A young fangirl of Gothic novels has to learn that dark romance is not always so appealing in real life. A deliciously satirical Austen classic.
Description_Notes_From_A_Small_Island: After two decades in Britain, this American author isn't afraid to draw his conclusions about the small, weird, lovely island that had become his second home.
Description_One_Of_Us_Is_Lying: When the Breakfast Club turns into a crime scene before detention is over, you know you'll be in for a thrilling, twisted mystery drama.
Description_Paper_Towns: Margo is a mystery in human form, and Quentin would love nothing more than to solve her. The young adult novel for those who are looking to love for the answer.
Description_Paradise: Morrison herself wanted to call this book War. Her groundbreaking novel chronicles the catastrophic happenings taking place in an all-Black Oklahoma town and its counterpart, the Convent.
Description_Persuasion: The 27-year-old Anne Elliot gets a second chance at love when her ex-fiance, Captain Frederick Wentworth, moves into her family's home. Another Austen classic that never gets old.
Description_Pet_Sematary: Sometimes, dead is better... Because whatever came back from the grave no longer answers to "Heeere, kitty!". Another horror staple from Maine's biggest fan, Stephen King.
Description_Rambles_in_Germany_and_Italy: While Italy held many painful memories for Mary Shelley, she returned to the places she had once called home as a political ally in Italy's fight for independence.
Description_Red_Dragon: The first novel in the Hannibal Lecter series introduces us to the infamous psychologist and cannibal, as he finds an unlikely ally in FBI profiler Will Graham. Absolutely gruesome and disturbing!
Description_Red,_White_&_Royal_Blue: The charming, cheeky, and slightly steamy rom-com where a First Son of America falls in love with a British crown prince, causing chaos, scandal, and plenty of swooning moments.
Description_Richard_Serra;_Interviews,_e: The Man Behind the Masterpieces: Explore the life and artistic vision of the legendary sculptor and modern art icon in this series of interviews, presented alongside marvellous black-and-white photographs of his life's work.
Description_Romeo_and_Juliet: No matter how many times you've seen it before, you will always be swept away by the passion and despair of these two lovers. And you might even be surprised by your own emotions.
Description_Salomé: According to a reviewer of the play at its original performance, it is "an arrangement in blood and ferocity, morbid, bizarre, repulsive." Now, we might view Salomé as a symbol of modernity, a challenge and a revolt against a patriarchal Victorian society.
Description_Second_Foundation: Asimov's world-famous sci-fi epic continues as secrets unravel around the 14-year-old Arkady, alliances form in a war for the galaxy, and the true power of the Second Foundation is revealed.
Description_Shakespeare;The_World_as_Sta: Unravel the enigmatic genius behind Shakespeare's words, as explained by Bill Bryson. A great and light-hearted introduction for every reader interested in the man behind the plays.
Description_Shatter_Me: The first in a series of young adult novels, set in a dystopian world where one girl's touch is lethal. Will she finally escape the grasp of the government? And will she find love in the meantime?
Description_Shirley: Shirley is a traditional Brontë romance with a titular intelligent and headstrong heiress. Yet, the novel also deals with themes of economic struggles after the introduction of "labour-saving machinery". Sound familiar, anyone?
Description_Six_of_Crows: A young adult fantasy heist novel set in the "Grishaverse", a dark world populated with magic users. Join the criminally talented Kaz Brekker as he gets together a crew of fellow teenage thieves to complete a dangerous task.
Description_Sky_Island: From Baum's much lesser known series of children's fantasy, Sky Island takes Trot, Button Bright, and Captain Bill to — you guessed it — an island in the sky. Illustrated by John R. Neill
Description_Slaughterhouse-Five: Billy Pilgrim travels back and forth in time due to his post-war psychological trauma. Vonnegut combines his own experiences as an American soldier in 1945 Dresden with science-fictional elements to create one of the most revered anti-war novels of all time.
Description_Snow_Crash: Hiro Protagonist (yes, that's really his name) is a hacker and pizza delivery driver in a dystopian, futuristic America. who comes across a very dangerous data file in the Metaverse.
Description_Stories_of_Your_Life_and_Oth: A collection of eight marvellous science-fiction short stories, asking the question that speculative fiction always asks best: "what if?"
Description_The_Anthropocene_Reviewed: Turned from a podcast into John Green's first non-fiction book, the writer rates various phenomena of the age of human intervention in nature on a scale of 1 to 5 stars.
Description_The_Autograph_Man: Alex-Li Tandem is a mess. He makes his living by selling celebrity autographs, drinks too much, cheats on his girlfriend, and is hunting down an American actress whose last film came out in the 1940s.
Description_The_Bad_Beginning;(A_Series_: When three siblings are suddenly orphaned, they have to live with their strange relative, Count Olaf. The failed actor wants to secure the family fortune for himself, but Violet, Klaus, and Sunny might stop him yet.
Description_The_Battle_of_the_Labyrinth: Percy Jackson and his friends must enter the Minoan labyrinth to continue their godly quest and fulfil another prophecy in this fourth entry in the Olympian fantasy series.
Description_The_Bell_Jar: Esther feels trapped in the confines of womanhood. After struggling with the expectations of marriage, sex, and work, and following multiple suicide attempts, she is hospitalised.
Description_The_Big_Sleep: The most heteronormatively masculine, "hard-boiled", noir detective story you'll ever read. In which PI Philip Marlowe uncovers a criminal plot and seduces "damsels" left and right.
Description_The_Blind_Assassin: Stories within stories intertwine in this gripping mystery as Iris looks back on decades of her life. She recalls her childhood, her failed marriage, a world war... and reveals many unforeseen secrets along the way.
Description_The_Bluest_Eye: This Morrison novel does not shy away from dealing with the devastating and harrowing consequences of the violence and abuse that were (and are still) inflicted upon young Black girls.
Description_The_Canterville_Ghost: Wilde's first published story is a classic ghost tale with lots of humour. Because what could be more fun than a bold American family moving into an estate haunted by an English aristocrat?
Description_The_Cask_of_Amontillado: Edgar did it again, a short story whose gruesome nature will linger much longer on your mind.
Description_The_Color_Purple: A striking epistolary novel that continuously insists on the solidarity, friendship, and romantic love between women of colour, even in the face of the greatest adversities.
Description_The_Comedy_of_Errors: This play might be less deep than what we are used to from Billy S., but the slapstick, puns, mishaps, and chaos could make any modern audience laugh.
Description_The_Complete_Robot: Sixty-two years after the first published instance of the word 'robot', Asimov collects his science-fiction short stories about the industrious automatons in this series.
Description_The_Cruel_Prince: Jude is a mortal living in the fae realm and is constantly tormented by the High Court. Worst of all is the youngest prince. But can she stand up to him without being roped into the intrigue of the palace?
Description_The_Curious_Incident_of_the_: Christopher might be only 15, but he notices things that others don't. When his neighbour's dog is suddenly killed, he wants to know what happened. This novel is unique in its use of maps, pictures, and diagrams!
Description_The_Decoration_of_Houses: Edith Wharton only became a writer at 40, and besides her many novels, she also wrote books on design, travel, and culture. At 60, she was the first woman to win a Pulitzer for Fiction. It is never too late to begin.
Description_The_Dispossessed: Are YOU looking for feminist, anarchist sci-fi? I'm told Le Guin's Hainish Cycle is the place to start. While this book is technically the fifth book in the series, it is also the first in the chronology. Confusing, I know.
Description_The_Duke_and_I: London's high society loves Daphne. Yet none of the eligible gentlemen are courting her so far. Can the brooding Duke of Hastings, who has no interest in marriage or society, help her raise her reputation?
Description_The_Essential_Rumi: The poetry and philosophy of the 13th-century Persian scholar known as Rumi have been among the most influential works in history.
Description_The_Eyes_of_Darkness: A year after her son's death, Tina begins seeing things... Did Danny really die in an accident? And who is trying to conceal the truth from her? A paranormal horror-thriller.
Description_The_Fall_of_the_House_of_Ush: American Gothic horror at its finest. Much like the guests of House Usher, you will never be quite the same after diving into this deliciously dark and tragic short story.
Description_The_Fault_in_Our_Stars: In the cancer support group her mother made her go to, 16-year-old Hazel meets Augustus. They share a love for books and metaphors and make each other rethink what it means to live, and what it means to die.
Description_The_Glass_Castle: Journalist Jeannette Walls recounts her unstable childhood and the fraught relationship with her parents in this bestselling memoir.
Description_The_God_of_Small_Things: The God of Small Things tells the dramatic story of twins from Kerala, India. They recall their childhood in 1969, as they grew up surrounded by family misery, political unrest, and forbidden love.
Description_The_Great_Gatsby: The glamorous tale of love and wealth that shaped the cultural imagination of "the roaring 1920s". Yet this story doesn't shy away from confronting the unknown dark sides of the "American Dream".
Description_The_Handmaid's_Tale: A dystopian tale that imagines a totalitarian state in which the majority of women have been stripped of their freedom and reproductive rights to serve a Christian fundamentalist elite of men and their wives.
Description_The_Happy_Prince_and_Other_T: A charming collection of illustrated children's tales written by the famous Irish playwright. Also includes The Nightingale and the Rose, The Selfish Giant, The Devoted Friend, and The Remarkable Rocket.
Description_The_Hidden_Staircase;(Nancy_: Join the clever teenage detective Nancy Drew as she solves the mystery of a mysterious haunting. A detective story for all ages.
Description_The_Hunger_Games: The twelve districts of Panem are barely held under control. To keep them from revolting, children from each are chosen for gladiator-like games. There can only be one survivor, so Katniss can't let her little sister be picked.
Description_The_Importance_of_Being_Earn: A hilarious and clever tale and a must-read for any fans of the Irish writer. A play that satirises Victorian society, from the author who ruffled many societal feathers.
Description_The_Invasion;(Animorphs_#1): Only 90s kids will remember wanting the ability to spontaneously transform into an animal. But be careful, because aliens are trying to infiltrate Earth and, if you don't change back, you might get stuck as a hawk forever!
Description_The_Invisible_Man: A mysterious stranger appears at a village inn, causing chaos with the experiments he hides in his room. When he is discovered to have made himself invisible, a wild chase ensues. A thrilling classic of early science fiction.
Description_The_Last_Battle;(Chronicles_: It is almost Judgment Day in Narnia. Like, actual Christian Judgment Day. Where Lion Jesus sends all of the good guys to heaven at the end. The metaphor is no longer subtle at all.
Description_The_Last_Wish;(The_Witcher): A dark and dangerous story about fate, sorcery, and monstrous creatures. Accompany the Witcher, Geralt of Rivia, on his reluctant adventure, where he discovers curses, promises, and lovers.
Description_The_Lightning_Thief;(Percy_J: In this tale of greek mythology, friendship and mediocre paternal figures for the ages, our young protagonist has to go on a mythic roadtrip to retrieve a stolen artifact or face Zeus's wrath.
Description_The_Little_Prince: An enchanting tale of love, loss and an adventurous little prince who explores the universe and his own feelings. One sees clearly only with the heart. A must read for all ages.
Description_The_Lorax: A furry creature speaks for the trees and shows us how capitalism is destroying nature. Don't be fooled by the clever rhymes, this children's book is a razor-sharp critique and hard-hitting warning.
Description_The_Lost_Symbol: Once again, symbologist Robert Langdom has to decode the secrets of old to save his mentor. This time in Washington D.C., there are undiscovered mysteries waiting for him.
Description_The_Love_Hypothesis: To convince her friends that she is over her ex, PhD student Olive convinces her young professor Adam to start a fake relationship. An example of fanfiction turned published book at its best.
Description_The_Magic_City: Out of discontent with his new life, young Philip builds a city out of his toys, books, and game pieces. Next thing he knows, he appears in a life-size version of it, populated with people who need his and Lucy's help.
Description_The_Magic_World: This collection contains twelve beautiful and poetic short stories for children, including tales of talking animals, monarchs, fairies and beasts, and magical worlds.
Description_The_Martian_Chronicles: This classic sci-fi short-story cycle chronicles the exploration and settlement of Mars by the U.S. in the far and distant future of 2030. Bradbury explores militarism, genocide, oppression, and censorship from his post-war perspective.
Description_The_Martian: Astro-botanist Mark Watney is left behind on Mars after his crew narrowly escaped a dust storm. Alone and without supplies, the incorrigible optimist has to improvise in order to survive.
Description_The_Maze_Runner: Thomas wakes up among other teenagers in the centre of an ever-changing maze without his memories. He soon learns that all they can do to survive is to try and escape by any means necessary.
Description_The_Murder_at_the_Vicarage: A quaint village, a nosy vicar and a most sinister murder. Join Miss Marple, the Queen of Crime, on a typical English murder mystery, full of exaggerated characters and dry wit.
Description_The_Murder_of_Roger_Ackroyd: This famous whodunnit harbours a twist you might not see coming. As detective Hercule Poirot leaves retirement to review the crime scene, all signs point to a locked room that no one could have gotten into.
Description_The_Mysterious_Affair_at_Sty: A book of many beginnings. The start of Christie's career as a prolific crime novelist. The first appearance of beloved Belgian detective Hercule Poirot. And a first in a long series of brilliant and suspenseful whodunnits.
Description_The_Napoleon_of_Notting_Hill: In this alternate universe, successors of the Throne of England are chosen through random selection. And while the newest king fails to take his position seriously, one inhabitant of Notting Hill upholds his whimsical decisions with vigour.
Description_The_Neverending_Story: When a little boy hides in the attic with a strange book, an exciting adventure begins in the book's fantasy world. A story about escapism and imagination for all of us who enjoyed hiding in our books.
Description_The_Outsiders: Written by the author when she was still a teenager herself, this coming-of-age novel is known for dealing with the socio-economic struggles of White American working-class teenagers and the "greaser" gangs they formed.
Description_The_Passage: The test subjects of a virus experiment develop strong physical and psychic abilities which cannot be controlled. The virus is spread and 90 years later, only a few colonies survive. One of them encounters the strange Amy...
Description_The_Perks_of_Being_a_Wallflo: Charlie doesn't fit in anywhere at his new school. He grapples with grief and flashbacks to his aunt's death. But two seniors take him under their wing, and Charlie experiences all the joy and despair of growing up.
Description_The_Picture_of_Dorian_Gray: The Narcissus myth of the Victorian times, Wilde's novel is a wonderfully Gothic exploration of the values of beauty, sensuality, and hedonism in their opposition to morality and social norms.
Description_The_Poems_of_Emily_Dickinson: A comprehensive collection of poetry written by a woman who never received much recognition for her work while she was alive.
Description_The_Ramayana: This epic folktale was hugely influential on storytellers of many eras and origins. Rama's exile and travels across the forest lead him into heroics, bloodbaths, battles with demons, and philosophical and spiritual wisdom.
Description_The_Raven: Once upon a dreary midnight, our protagonist is haunted by a raven in this beautifully painful poem about love and loss. Warning, it might leave you pondering weak and weary.
Description_The_Sea_of_Monsters;(Percy_J: Mythical monsters, cursed cruise ships and unexpected friends accompany our Olympian teenagers in this divine sequel to the fantastic Percy Jackson series.
Description_The_Seven_Husbands_of_Evelyn: This historical drama follows Evelyn Hugo, an old Hollywood star, as she prepares her spicy tell-all biography, full of highs and lows, queer love, and tragedies.
Description_The_Seven_Lamps_of_Architect: This dry essay is a must-read for fans of gothic revival and a fun insight into the minds of 1800s mid-century architects. If you've ever wondered how architects 200 years ago contemplated their craft, this one's for you.
Description_The_Shining: A haunted hotel, a writer with writer's block, his fraught marriage, and the creepiest children in literature. What could possibly go wrong?
Description_The_Silence_of_the_Lambs: A chilling thriller that won't let you go. Follow an FBI trainee as she struggles to cooperate with a cunning and cannibalistic psychopath to catch another serial killer.
Description_The_Silmarillion: Tolkien finally takes his time to write his own religious scripture about the creation of Middle-earth. Perfect for all closeted fantasy-theologians.
Description_The_Song_of_Achilles: A marvellous retelling of the timeless classical epos, the Iliad, that focuses on the things that really matter. Complicated parents, the merciless politics of war, and, of course, the greatest love story of them all.
Description_The_Soul_of_Man_Under_Social: Wilde sharply outlines the economic realities of his time and prescribes humanistic socialism as a cure. What might have been a hot take today was instead published as an essay packed with stellar quotes in 1891.
Description_The_Stand: A guttingly dark exploration of a bioweapon-turned-pandemic wiping out most of humanity, and the struggle of good vs. evil amongst the survivors left in its wake. Not for the faint of heart.
Description_The_Tell-Tale_Heart: Ba-bump, ba-bump, ba-bump. You killed someone and now the investigators are here. Ba-bump, ba-bump, ba-bump. Surely they must hear it, too. How will Poe's delightfully chilling short story end?
Description_The_Tempest: In this Shakespearean classic, a wizarding scholar is disposed of by his brother and forced to take a sabbatical on a desolate island. A play full of thundering monologues, magical confusions and romantic distractions.
Description_The_Travels_of_Marco_Polo: In this totally real travelogue from the 13th century, we follow the author's self-insert — conveniently named Marco Polo — on his legendary travels from Venice to Beijing.
Description_The_War_of_the_Worlds: One of the first instances of Martians invading Earth. How will humanity defend itself? A great example of the what if they did to us what we did to others kind of sci-fi horror.
Description_The_Well_at_the_World's_End: Turns out the brilliant poet and designer William Morris also wrote a Fantasy classic. This beautifully illustrated book follows a young adventurer in an action-packed world of fading magic.
Description_The_Willows: This wonderfully twisted gothic horror classic follows two friends on a fateful canoe trip. Scary campsite encounters and weird nature—this otherworldly thriller will make you relieved to be in the comfort of your home.
Description_The_Woman_in_White: The young art teacher Walter Hartright finds himself entangled in a complicated family mystery. Will he find out the underlying secret that led to the tragedy? Be prepared for a twist in this spooky classic.
Description_The_Yellow_Fairy_Book: A collection of some of the most well-known fairytales of European history. The many folktales, from Icelandic to Ukrainian to Estonian to Greek, are translated and edited for all children to enjoy.
Description_They_Both_Die_at_the_End: Life's expiration date is non-negotiable in this heart-wrenching story of two teenage boys spending their last 24 hours together. A story of love, hope, and death.
Description_Titus_Andronicus: Follow the worst of the Romans, as he does the worst things in the worst ways possible. An incredibly violent Shakespeare play, not for the faint of heart, filled with revenge, monologues, and pies.
Description_To_Kill_a_Mockingbird: A timeless story of justice and innocence in a small Southern town where a lawyer takes on a charged case amid the prejudices and tensions of Depression-era Alabama.
Description_To_the_Lighthouse: The Ramsay family spends the summer on the Isle of Skye with a few of their guests. Among them, a young painter observes the tensions and relationships between the family members and how they change 10 years later.
Description_Treasure_Island: A young boy finds himself in the possession of a pirate treasure map in this classic story of treachery and treasure that will have your kids dreaming of becoming a pirate.
Description_True_Beauty;Volume_1: After being bullied for her appearance in middle school, Jugyeong starts over with a new look. After mastering the art of makeup, none of her new friends know what her face really looks like. The first print of the popular Korean webtoon.
Description_Twenty_Thousand_Leagues_Unde: In this steampunk classic, a group of scientists around Captain Nemo unexpectedly embarks on an unforgettable underwater adventure in the Nautilus.
Description_Twisted_Love: In romance, there is something for everyone. This book is for the crowd who hear "possessive asshole, and her brother's best friend" and swoon.
Description_Unmasking_Autism: This book shares the author's personal experience with Autistic masking, extensive research on the history of the topic, as well as actionable advice and exercises to encourage self-expression. A ground-breaking work on neurodiversity.
Description_Upgrading_and_Repairing_PCs: The definitive guide to everything PC-related. Scott really makes it sound easy—a book for PC repair enthusiasts and those who might want to upgrade all the way to an unbelievable 64 megabytes of RAM!
Description_Valperga: A historical novel set in the Middle Ages, by certified goth nerd Mary Shelley. Mirroring the struggles of women in Shelley's time, the female protagonist must choose between love and political liberty.
Description_Villette: Lucy is hired as a governess in Villette, France, where she faces loneliness, illness, friendship, and eventually love. A novel famous for its plot twists, thanks to a narrator who frequently hides information from the readers.
Description_Violets_Are_Blue: In this thrilling and bloody case, Detective Alex Cross investigates another macabre murder with undeniable signs of vampires while being haunted by someone from his past.
Description_Watchmen;(Issue_#12): In the world of Watchmen, superheroes emerged in the 1940s and altered history as we know it with their presence. Tune in for the twelfth and last issue of the iconic comic series.
Description_Where_the_Wild_Things_Are: As a child, throwing a tantrum is fun and all, until you find yourself in the middle of a group of "wild things". This delightful classic is about the important things, like dancing in the moonlight and missing your mum.
Description_White_Teeth: This postcolonial novel focuses on the friendship of two wartime friends, a Bangladeshi and an Englishman. The story about mixed families, clashing ideologies and activism comes to a dramatic conclusion.
Description_Wuthering_Heights: The only novel Emily Brontë ever wrote, and it's a masterpiece! A haunting tale of love and abuse set amidst the austere Yorkshire moors.
Description_You've_Reached_Sam: When the 17-year-old Julie loses Sam, the shared future they imagined dies with him and everything changes. All she wants now is to hear his voice again when she calls his phone. And against all odds, it doesn't go to voicemail...
Description_By_Train_Through_Spain: Join this charming and colourful journey across Spain with Amerigo Marchesi as they hop on trains, capture stunning vistas and uncover fascinating hidden gems.
Description_Discovering_the_Greater_Book: Join Peter Spinner as he looks for the well-kept hidden gems of the enchanting Greater Bookston Region. High-quality restaurants, cosy stays, endearing shops, and local events await!
Description_Encyclopaedia_Bookstonia_Vol: Get ready for a mind-blowing journey through the wondrous world of knowledge! Volume 2 of Encyclopaedia Bookstonia: from D as in Detective Novels to J as in Japanese Manga.
Discover a world of knowledge and adventure in this thrilling third volume of Encyclopaedia Bookstonia. From K as in Knitting Instructions to O as in Omegaverse.
Another epic volume filled with knowledge and wonder! What else does this encyclopaedia series have in store? I'll tell you: Entries from P as in Philosophy to T as in True Crime.
Vol. 5 of this encyclopaedia concludes our journey of learning, with the entries we've all been waiting for: U as in Unfinished Manuscripts to Y as in Yuri. (They forgot to print Z).
Description_Finding_Optimism;The_Future_: Liliane Renaud believes that, despite everything, the future must be bright. This solarpunk-inspired work is packed with thoughtful poems and practical insights to guide you through life's most difficult challenges.
Description_Herbcraft;The_Power_of_Natur: Get ready to brew up some magic as Star Ravenhunt shares the secrets of herbcraft, from natural healing potions to delicious recipes to mischievous hexes.
Description_Historical_Niche: This in-depth exploration of the Danelaw by a scholar of history promises sophisticated insights for anyone with an interest in 886–1066 AD in Northern England.
Description_HTML_1998;An_Introduction: Get ready to enter the digital world with this 90s guide to HTML (specifically 3.2), the language that powers the internet. Let's say "Hello, World!"
Description_In_Search_Of:;The_Most_Beaut: The newest entry in our In Search Of series: A marvellous view across stunning islands, where paradise awaits at every turn, even if you're on a budget.
Description_Just_A_Story:_Why_We_Still_T: Once upon a time... there was the captivating world of fairytales. Discover why these timeless tales continue to enchant and intrigue us in this cultural and anthropological study.
Description_Kitchen_Rules_For_Your_Famil: Spice up your family's kitchen adventures with this delightful guide. From cooking tips to family bonding, discover the recipe for a happy home!
Description_Living_In_Alaska: This chilling page-turner, based on Jones' true story, will take you on a wild journey through the frozen wilderness of Alaska, filled with heartbreak, resilience, and unexpected turns.
Description_Medieval_Carpentry: Woodworking tips and tricks from the days of knights and castles. Unearth ancient techniques and bring medieval craftsmanship back to life!
Description_Mesopotamian_Buildings: Discover the awe-inspiring marvels crafted by ancient hands in this fascinating delve into Mesopotamian architecture. Join us on a journey through time!
Description_Physics_1908: Discover the captivating world of physics through a historical journey that will tickle your brain and transport you to 1908.
Description_Round_Luxembourg_with_Brooke: Join rising Instagram star BrookeTravels on an adventure through Luxembourg as she explores, shares delicious recipes, and provides a refreshing take on travel and lifestyle.
Description_St._Bookston:_The_Myth,_the_: The most brilliant writer and philosopher of his time. But who was he really? And why do we know so little about his life? Finally uncover the truth in this groundbreaking investigative biography.
Description_The_Debvoir_Family;A_Success: Follow the triumphs and trials of a remarkable family, as the Debvoir clan shapes and is challenged by the very history of Bookstonbury.
Description_Top_50_Camper_Van_Destinatio: From winding coastal roads to serene mountain retreats, this comprehensive camping guide unveils a collection of breathtaking landscapes and hidden gems.
Description_Traditional_Building_Techniq: Have you ever looked at an old city's houses, castles and bridges and asked yourself: "How did they build that"? This book illustrates the greatest building techniques of all time and what we can learn from them today.
Description_A_Clash_of_Kings: The 2nd volume in the ASOIAF series continues to deliver the most heart-wrenching twists and tragedies of medieval fantasy: mysteries of parentage, magic, murder, war, and epic adventures all throughout the lands of Westeros.
Description_A_Court_of_Mist_and_Fury: Get ready for a sexy, epic and twisting book two in the fantasy series, where the immortal intrigue of the fae courts unfolds around haunted protagonist Feyre. What will she do with her new powers and her complicated bonds to two High Fae Lords?
Description_A_Feast_for_Crows: The war for the Iron Throne seems to have burned itself out to a truce... for now. But it wouldn't be A Song of Ice and Fire without some deceit, ambitious plotting, power struggles, and mysterious sorcery at work.
Description_A_Midsummer_Night's_Dream: Simple love triangles are for beginners. In this classic play, romantic entanglements involve four young, love-sick Greeks, fae royalty, enchantment spells, and a donkey, resulting in a comedy for the ages.
Description_A_Walk_in_the_Woods: The tale of two men in their forties, with countless blisters and a questionable map, on the Appalachian Trail. Get to know the area's history, ecology, and people in this hilarious exploration of the great outdoors.
Description_Alice's_Adventures_in_Wonder: Follow a curious girl as she tumbles down the rabbit hole, into a world filled with talking animals and puzzling adventures. A classic tale of nonsense and whimsy, illustrated by John Tenniel.
Description_All's_Well_That_Ends_Well: Sometimes, a happy ending can be a woman getting the man she wanted, even if he's generally quite unpleasant. Shakespearean drama and confusion as it should be.
Description_Before_the_Coffee_Gets_Cold: In this heartwarming and thought-provoking story, a cosy cafe in Tokyo has a mysterious twist... Can you change the past, or will the coffee get cold before you do?
Description_Beowulf: An Old English epos that still puzzles scholars to this day. Who can we credit for this poetic tale of a Scandinavian folk hero? When was it written? And how much does it tell us about our history?
Description_Blood_of_Elves;(The_Witcher): After the success of previous short stories, the Polish fantasy series now takes off into its first novel, wherein the magically gifted Ciri must flee from her war-torn home, and comes under the protection of Geralt of Rivia.
Description_Carrie: A classic of dark teen horror. High schooler Carrie White is mercilessly bullied by her peers and abused by her religious mother. But when an especially cruel prank is used to humiliate her, her latent telekinetic powers know no bounds.
Description_Catching_Fire: The cycle established in the dystopian society of Panem continues. The brutal Hunger Games are held again, and traumatised Katniss and Peeta get no choice but to play along, and fight not only for their survival, but also for a revolution...
Description_Crime_and_Punishment: Poverty and guilt drive a bright young man to a dark deed. How will he grapple with the consequences of his crime?
Description_Don_Quixote: A mad "knight" embarks on hilarious adventures with his faithful, not-so-bright sidekick in this classic satire.
Description_Dune: An epic saga of intergalactic politics and precious resources, where one young man finds himself surrounded by inhospitable desert, and at the centre of a messianic prophecy.
Description_Fire_&_Blood: Finally, an even more historical fantasy novel, from the world of Ice and Fire. Wherein all the messy relationships, wars, and secrets of the royal Targaryen dynasty are aired out.
Description_Frank_Lloyd_Wright: From prairie houses to the Guggenheim museum, this architect had range! This wonderful coffee table book is jam-packed with sketches and photographs for all architecture enjoyers.
Description_Frankenstein: Oh, to be 18 again, and write a masterpiece over a particularly cold and dark summer holiday, unknowingly laying the very foundation of our modern horror fiction. Wish that were me.
Description_Ghost_Stories;From_the_Grave: Prepare to be chilled to the bone as you journey into the realm of the supernatural with this collection of eerie and haunting tales. With Dickens, Stoker, Wilde, and Poe, as well as new stories.
Description_Great_Expectations: A classic Dickens! Poverty, morality, smelly cities, and unjust austerity measures lead to a rags-to-riches extravaganza with a lot of heartbreak on the way. Oh, right, I forgot orphans.
Description_Heinemann_Mathematics: The classic textbook for everyone's favourite subject in school! Packed with all the greatest hits like arithmetic, trigonometry, and stochastics.
Description_Howl,_and_Other_Poems: There are nice poems, and then there are those tried by the law in an obscenity trial: Radical, honest, political, soft, holy. And life-changing. I much prefer the latter category.
Description_I,_Robot: This set of nine delightful short stories imagine a world of robot and human colaboration and explores some interesting concepts within this framing. A foundational text of modern Sci-Fi, and a must read in the storebought version of the future we ended up in.
Description_If_Tomorrow_Comes: A thrilling mystery about a regular woman's descent into a life of crime. Betrayed by love and framed by the mafia, Tracy has to fight back to survive.
Description_Inkheart: Pen and paper can bring characters to life, but what happens when they escape the page? The beginning of a fantastical and dangerous adventure into the world of a book, for all ages.
Description_Jane_Eyre: This intimately narrated story of the winding life of Jane Eyre touches on many social issues present in Victorian England. Her story is frought with twists and hardships but ultimately leads to love.
Description_Jean_Dubuffet: Explore the fascinating world of French artist, Jean Debuffet. Learn how he strived to thwart conventional standards of beauty in favour of more authentic and humanistic ways of image making.
Description_Henry_VI,_Part_1: Watch as personal squabbles, petty jealousy and Joan of Arc tear apart the English political system in this first part of Shakespeare's King Henry VI trilogy.
Description_Henry_VI,_Part_3: This final part of Shakespeare's King Henry VI trilogy focuses on the horrors that ensued during the Wars of the Roses as the nation is thrown into chaos and morality makes way for revenge.
Description_Richard_II: Shakespeare's classic historical drama about the downfall of King Richard the Second, complete with scheming nobles and history-defining power politics.
Description_Les_Miserables:
19th-century Paris. A man running from the law just wants a chance to live his life. Injustice is everywhere. But resistance is brewing, and love is not far.
Caution: This is a very long and arguably dry historical novel, not a fun play or catchy musical.
Description_Looking_for_Alaska: Boarding school is not what Miles thought it was gonna be. And neither is that girl he meets, Alaska. Together they search for the meaning behind last words in this heartbreaking YA drama.
Description_Lord_of_the_Flies: A group of school boys is suddenly stranded on a remote island. Will they manage to survive without any grownups, or will they succumb to their darker instincts?
Description_Maria_Stuart: A Tudor tale of power, betrayal, and queens. Witness the captivating drama and heart-wrenching decisions of a regal Mary, in this loveletter to Shakespearian plays by a legendary German playwright.
Description_Matilda: A mischievous little genius delights in books and uses her powers to outsmart nasty grown-ups. Will she make it through the school system in one piece?
Description_Miss_Peregrine's_Home_for_Pe: More than just peculiar, these children seem downright supernatural! Follow along this haunting adventure about found family and not fitting in, illustrated with vintage photography.
Description_Mont-Saint-Michel_and_Chartr: A fictional travelogue, self-described as "not anything that can possibly be useful or instructive — but only a sense of what those centuries had to say, and a sympathy with their ways of saying it."
Description_Mother_Night: An American in Germany turned spy during World War II, is facing trial as a Nazi war criminal. Does the vital role he inadvertently played in the Nazi propaganda machine make him guilty?
Description_Mrs._Dalloway: Get to know Clarissa as she prepares for a party later that evening. Learn about her life and meet her guests while pondering human nature and exploring the social structures of the 1920s. Will her party be a success?
Description_Much_Ado_About_Nothing: A web of love, lies and misunderstandings encircle four lovers. Laugh along as their lives get turned upside down in this punny romp about jealousy and trust.
Description_Night_and_Day: Can love and marriage coexist and is marriage necessary for happiness? Explore love and life in Edwardian London as night and day contrast just as the lives of Katherine and Mary.
Description_Night_Sky_with_Exit_Wounds: This collection of poetry courageously explores violence and the delicacy of life. The author tells of the Vietnam War, of his experience with 9/11, and of queer love.
Description_On_Beauty: Follow the increasingly intertwining lives of two very different academic families as their ideologies clash and their struggle with black identity and the nature of beauty unfolds.
Description_Orlando: A medley through over three centuries of history, featuring a suave protagonist and lots of moments of self-discovery. Filled with passionate affairs, bittersweet moments, bending the rules of time, class, and gender.
Description_Othello: The heroic black general Othello soon finds himself in the middle of intrigue and betrayal after one fateful promotion. The start of a brutal tragedy about someone who “loved not wisely but too well”.
Description_P.S._I_Still_Love_You: In this bittersweet sequel to a YA bestseller, Lara Jean's turbulent romantic life doesn't slow down at all. She begins to date Peter, but his close relationship with his ex gives her doubts...
Description_Pageboy: This memoir details Page's journey of self-discovery, and of overcoming the many hurdles put up by a transphobic and misogynistic film industry, to get to where he is now.
Description_Parable_of_the_Sower: In a dystopian world ravaged by climate change and corporate greed, a young woman embarks on a biblical journey to spread the seeds of a new religion in an attempt to redeem humanity.
Description_Persepolis;The_Story_of_a_Ch: A visually stunning and bold graphic novel memoir following a young Iranian girl through the 1970s and 1980s. This gripping story explores themes of revolution, religion, family, history and daily life in the face of tumultuous times.
Description_Peter_Pan_in_Kensington_Gard: A story about a mischivious boy who becomes stuck "Betwixt-and-Between" childhood and growing up, between the real world and the magical world of Kensington Gardens after dark.
Description_Prince_Caspian;The_Return_to: Our sibling protagonists suddenly return to a changed Narnia, and must help their friends defeat an evil despot making a play for power.
Description_Saga;Volume_9: Star Wars meets Game of Thrones! This ninth entry in the Saga series of graphic novels explores fake news and genuine terror in an epic sci-fi setting. Prepare for a heart-warming tale full of tragic twists.
Description_Scott_Pilgrim's_Precious_Lit: A quirky graphic novel about a nonchalant slacker turned romantic hero who must defeat his crush's seven evil exes. It's a pretty clever metaphor for feeling insecure about your new partners romantic past, or so I am told.
Description_Sense_and_Sensibility: A tale of two sisters, romantic engagements, quarrels, and the difficulty of making sensible and sensual choices in matters of love and marriage of course. Austen's delightful wit and sharp characterizations are great as ever in this all-time classic.
Description_Sister_Outsider: A collection of boundary-breaking essays and speeches in which author Audre Lorde negotiates her complex identity as a Black woman, lesbian, poet, activist, cancer survivor, mother, and feminist.
Description_Starstruck;(Deluxe_Edition): It’s a tough galaxy out there, but somebody's gotta live in it, and it might as well be YOU! The brilliant, feminist, sci-fi play turned comic book series that you may not have heard of yet.
Description_Stormbreaker: Ever dreamt of becoming a teenage spy for MI6 and uncovering a nefarious plot? The plot may be a little ridiculous but you probably won't care as you race along this thrilling first entry in the Alex Rider series.
Description_Sula: The story of the friendship between two young Black girls and the conflicting paths that their lives take them on. Read on as their opposing personalities affect the town in a tale about defying social norms, resentment and reconciliation.
Description_The_Adventures_of_Sherlock_H: Join the brilliant detective and his loyal companion on thrilling investigations as they unravel mysteries and outwit criminals in 12 legendary tales.
Description_The_Book_of_Tea: An open letter to the west, learn all about the Japanese values of Teaism and let them enrich your life. One of the great English tea classics that bridges the gap between the spritual and secular spheres of tea.
Description_The_Canterbury_Tales: Twenty-four stories told by twenty-four pilgrims as they travel to Canterbury Cathedral. Who can tell the most enthralling one and win a free meal at the Tabard Inn? This classic piece of English literature has been thought to have popularized the language in mainstream literature, but was it ever finished?
Description_The_Count_of_Monte_Cristo: In this epic tale of revenge, redemption, and exquisite French drama, a betrayed lover returns to the Parisian high society in search of sweet revenge.
Description_The_Fellowship_of_the_Ring: An unlikely band of heroes must go on a quest to destroy an evil ring once and for all. Their journey through Tolkien's vibrant fantasy world has become part of the foundation of modern fantasy literature.
Description_The_Girl_Who_Played_with_Fir: This book must be one of the darkest Nordic crime thrillers out there. Still, Larsson manages to sneak in moments of kindness and allyship that make this brutal revenge epos just barely possible to endure.
Description_The_Green_Mile: The heart-wrenching story of a death-row inmate with magical abilities. Prepare for a sordid tale of a corrupt and cruel institution and of the mouse that survived it all.
Description_The_Gunslinger: The last gunslinger's treacherous search for his ancient adversary leads him across an alternate reality Old West. A path full of monsters, demons and sacrifice lead to his ultimate destination: The Dark Tower.
Description_The_House_with_a_Clock_in_It: A ticking time-clock threatens to destroy the world. A newbie and a local boy team up to stop the magical doomsday plot. Join them in this illustrated romp full of black magic, ghosts and derring-do.
Description_The_Lion,_the_Witch_and_the_: In this delightful classic siblings stumble upon a magical world through an ordinary wardrobe, where talking animals and a wicked witch await.
Description_The_Lost_Continent: Classic fantasy meets greek mythology in this 1972 retelling of the legend of Atlantis. A heroic warrior priest is all that stands between an avaricious empress and the end of an era.
Description_The_Odyssey: A legendary Greek epos about a perilous journey home, with many mythical roadblocks along the way. Good thing, our protagonist is smart as a whip, and nobody is able to stop him.
Description_The_Outsider: The terrifying Outsider stalks Flint City, committing heinous crimes. Tag along a rag-tag team of heroes who take it upon themselves to deal with this nightmare in classic Stephen King fashion.
Description_The_Poetry_of_Architecture: Perhaps the origins of cottage core? John Ruskin will take you on a tour of his favourite cottages and villas throughout Europe. Delight in his philosophical musings about the beautiful interplay of nature and architecture.
Description_The_Return_of_the_King: The legendary showdown between good and evil, bravery and cowardice, love and doubt in a fantasy world on the brink of collapse. In between it all are some of the most poetic character moments in writing history.
Description_The_Scarecrow_of_Oz: Return to the land of Oz and embark on a typically Ozian adventure lined with quirky characters and unlikely scenarios. Join Cap'n Bill, Trot and a magical Scarecrow as they take down dastardly King Krewl.
Description_The_Shadow_of_the_Wind: He possesses the only known copy of a mysterious book by an even more mysterious author. Join Daniel on his treacherous journey to uncover the story of the book and its author in this winding neo-gothic novel.
Description_The_Silent_Patient: A terrifying delve into the twisted mind of Alicia Berenson. What moved her to suddenly murder her husband? And will the search for the truth be too much to bear...
Description_The_Snowy_Day: A young Black boy explores his neighbourhood transformed by the magic of snow. The beautiful illustrations of this charming story helped pave the way for more inclusive representation in children's literature.
Description_The_Stones_of_Venice: A thoroughly researched exploration of Venitian art and architecture, comprised of three groundbreaking volumes. If you have a soft spot for hard rocks, get this!
Description_The_Strange_Case_of_Dr._Jeky: In this fantastic gothic horror thriller not everything is as it seems, when a violent madman begins an escalating crime spree in London. As a lawyer begins investigating these mysterious incidents, a brilliant exploration of identities and dark urges ensues.
Description_The_Two_Towers: In this second book in Tolkien's foundational fantasy epic, the forces of evil have not been idle, and so our protagonists see themselves surrounded by evil creatures and poor advisors.
Description_The_Westing_Game: 16 heirs must pair up to solve the mystery of eccentric millionaire Sam Westing's last will and testament, all to win his vast fortune. Puzzle along as the twist and turns of this clever case unfold.
Description_Towards_a_New_Architecture: This polarizing manifesto calls for a new architecture for modern times. A foundational text to understand Corbusier's work, brutalism and mid-century architectural movements.
Description_Ugly_Love: He doesn't want love, and she doesn't have time for it. Sounds like a perfect arrangement with benefits, right? If only people and their hearts were so simple...
Description_White_Night: Wizard detective Harry Dresden is back in the 9th instalment of The Dresden Files. His new case takes him into Chicago's seedy underbelly as he tracks a vicious serial killer of magical practitioners.
Description_Witch_Wood: The devil lurks in the Witch Wood, or so people say. A disappearing minister, a satanic cult and a ravaging plague, but what lies at the bottom of it all? Find out in this Scottish masterpiece.
Description_Zaha_Hadid: Concrete, light, curves! This coffee table book is packed with some of contemporary architecture's finest works by visionary architect Zaha Hadid.
Description_Adventures_of_A_Wild_Child: Join the escapades of a free-spirited wanderer as they navigate love, self-discovery, and countless adventures in this captivating memoir.
Description_An_Explorer's_Guide_to_Georg: Discover the secrets of Georgetown in this fun and beautifully illustrated guide. Explore its history, indulge in local cuisine, and soak up the vibrant lifestyle.
Description_Catching_Carps: Reel in this absolute catch of a book, because Carpum's fishing trip is something special! Weaving together carp facts, personal philosophy, and globetrotting tales, the author shares all his wisdom.
Description_Encyclopaedia_Bookstonia_Vol: Discover a treasure trove of knowledge in this captivating encyclopaedia! From A as in Academia to C as in Crime, learn more about what makes the world of books go round.
Description_Gemology:_A_Study_in_Ruby: Unearth the secrets of the dazzling gemstones in this sparkling study of gemology. A challenging academic text from an expert of the field.
Description_Hiking_Trails_in_Bookston_Ba: Get lost and find yourself amidst the stunning natural beauty of Bookston Bay's secret hiking trails. Stunning coastal vistas await around every corner!
Description_Into_the_Sunset:_The_Magical: Explore the mythical and exotic lands of Western Europe. This satirical travelogue series lets you in on the secret wisdom and mysterious culture of the West.
Description_My_Travels_In_East_Africa: From Burundi to Uganda, an ageing adventurer shares his eye-opening journey through Eastern Africa, learning life's greatest lessons along the way.
Description_The_Secret_History_of_Bookst: An insight into the forgotten anecdotes of history, which was hugely popular in 1953 and still makes for an entertaining read. However, most of these historical "theories" have since been disproven.
Description_Hélène: A romantic reinterpretation of the Illiad. Hélène, a 16th-century version of Helen of Troy, has the chance to forever change the trajectory of her life and love. A historical play and a St. Bookston classic for a reason!
Description_A_Collection_of_Poems: A collection of Saint Bookston's greatest works of poetry, including Ashen Grey, Prometheus' Regrets, and Last Breaths.
Description_A_Senseless_Power: A timeless family drama by the brilliant Bookston. The three sons of a rich merchant family are vying for their powerful mother's approval. Will their quest for the matriarch's position be worth the destruction they sow on their ways to the top?
Description_On_the_Naturale_Flora_of_Boo: A taxonomy of the flora of Bookston Bay from the late 16th century. With hand-drawn illustrations by the polymath Saint Bookston.
Description_Rebecca: Our protagonist is freshly married to a rich manor lord. At her new home, expectations of a carefree married life are shattered when questions about Rebecca, the late lady of the house, arise.
Description_Carmilla: The lesbian vampire story you didn't know you needed! This classic gothic horror novel details young Laura's encounter with a new guest at her father's castle, a young woman named Carmilla.
Description_Anne_of_Green_Gables: Anne of Green Gables is the redheaded and feisty orphan girl you can't help but love! This charming children's classic is beloved by readers of all ages around the world.
Description_Guards!_Guards!: If you're looking to get into the Discworld series, this 8th tale is the one to start with. (There's a lot of them!) Adventure awaits the magical lands of Ankh-Morpork, when a long-lost "noble" dragon suddenly returns and is promptly crowned King.
Description_The_Haunting_of_Hill_House: In this tense horror classic, a group surrounding an "expert of the occult" are investigating the mysterious Hill House. But inside, they are awaited by more than just spooky poltergeists...
Description_Dinosaurs_and_other_Prehisto: A collection of over 90 prehistoric plants and animals, stunningly illustrated by Angela Rizza and Daniel Long. In this remarkable guide, readers of all ages may find their new favourite fossil!
Description_Newtonian_Physics_for_Babies: This book is the only physics guide truly written for everyone! Whether you are only months old or already retired, this cheeky picture book might make a genius out of you yet.
Description_The_Adventures_of_Pippi_Long: Follow the energetic escapades of young Pippi, the girl with the red braids who lives all alone in her big colourful house with her trusty pet monkey always at her side, and who doesn't listen to what the boring adults have to say.
Description_Codename_Villanelle: An assassin going by the codename "Villanelle" has recently appeared on the map, killing some of the most influential men in international politics. Can former MI6 agent Eve find and catch this eccentric psychopath?
Description_Moominland_Midwinter: The Moomins are lovable small creatures, invented by the Finnish illustrator, who live a peaceful life in the forest. In the 8th book of the classic children's series, little Moomintroll wakes up during winter hibernation and has to be very brave about it.
Description_The_Witch_Boy: In Aster's family, boys aren't meant to be witches, they're supposed to grow into shapeshifters. But at 13, Aster still hasn't shifted, and when his friends need help, his fascination with witchcraft might be the only thing that can help. A graphic novel for adventurous middle-grade readers.
Description_The_Bookshop_Book: Get a glimpse into the most unusual bookshops around the world and fall in love with their proprietor's passion for the trade. I might be biased, but if you ask me, this love letter to weird and wonderful bookshops is only missing one entry (*chrm* yours truly *chrm*).
Description_What_We_Don't_Talk_About;Whe: This revolutionary book aims to challenge the cultural attitudes and systemic biases behind anti-fatness and calls for a social justice movement that includes fat activism.
Description_Witch_Hat_Atelier;_Volume_1: How can Coco ever become a witch if she was born without the gift of magic? Well, a mysterious magician might hold the missing puzzle pieces for her dreams to come true! This popular manga series promises loveable characters and a whole lot of magic.
Description_The_Surgeon: A sadistic serial killer is on the loose in Boston, and evidence of his surgical skills leads investigator Rizzoli to suspect that he might be a physician. A dark and twisted thriller and the first in the popular Rizzoli & Isles crime series.
Description_Tasting_History;Explore_the_: Have you ever wondered what people were cooking during the Great Depression? Or did you always want to try a recipe from Ancient Rome? Max Miller was curious about the same thing, and this fun book recreates his viral cooking adventures for the page.
Description_Happily_Ever_After_Cookbook;: Book-inspired recipes! Need I say more? When bestselling romance authors team up with chefs to create their own dishes, you might be in for a treat! Try it at home!
Description_Cook_Korean!;A_Comic_Book_wi: Most people like having visual aids in their recipes. But this book takes illustrated cooking to the next level! Enjoy this colourful and fun guide to Korean cuisine, and make cooking new recipes more fun than ever.
Description_Cook_As_You_Are;Recipes_for_: Sometimes, our lives just don't leave space for cooking. Or do they? These delicious recipes work for all kinds of situations, whether you need last-minute inspiration, only have one clean pot, or can't easily chop ingredients.
Description_The_Stonewall_Reader: This curated anthology chronicles the Stonewall uprisings after fifty years through articles, first accounts, and more. Iconic activists and forgotten revolutionaries, who were indispensable to the gay liberation movement, tell their stories.
Description_We_Are_Bridges;A_Memoir: To come to terms with a new stage in her life, Cassandra explores what that family memory means to her. She carries on a tradition of Black Women's storytelling and history-keeping to contrast her present day with the South in the early 20th century.
Description_Hawaii's_Story_by_Hawaii's_Q: Queen Lili'uokalani was the last reigning monarch of Hawai'i, before the kingdom was overthrown and annexed as a territory of the United States of America. A unique and informative autobiography.
Description_Botany_in_a_Day;The_Patterns: Want to impress your friends and family with this great plant identification party trick? This book covers more than 100 plant families and how to spot their common features. Become a botany expert!
Description_Entangled_Life;_How_Fungi_Ma: They can make us healthy, make us sick, make us drunk or high, or grow on our graves once we are gone. Merlin Sheldrake (what a great name) lets us in on the secrets of the fungi, the coolest lifeform on Earth.
Description_The_Origin_of_Species: Charles Darwin's groundbreaking research on natural selection became one of the founding texts of modern biology and science. His discoveries were used to argue against a creationist belief system and created the grounds for a new study of evolution.
Description_A_Psalm_for_the_Wild-Built: In a beautifully futuristic world running on solar power and mutual aid, our protagonist, Dex, lives a very fulfilling life as a monk. Still, something is missing in their life, and something calls them on a journey into the wilderness.
Description_The_Royal_Horticultural_Soci: With this reference work, it is easier than ever to pick up gardening! Simply follow the guides, made easy with the help of over 3000 photographs, or look up any questions you might have about your plants. Guaranteed green thumb!
Description_Annihilation: Why has every previous expedition into Area X ended in a horrible tragedy? And what actually hides inside the contaminated zone? Four scientists are sent to find out in this first volume of a tense cosmic horror trilogy.
Description_The_Fisherman: It begins as a slow, melancholy tale of two widowed fishermen in upstate New York. But this unusual horror epic quickly turns into a deeply moving and intimate nightmare that will leave you awake at night.
Description_The_Sea_Around_Us: An incredible insight into the history of our oceans, their influence and power, but also their fragility, written by American marine biologist and conservationist Rachel Carson.
Description_Spirals_in_Time;_The_Secret_: Helen Scales has the perfect name for a marine biologist and wrote the perfect book for all of us who are fascinated by members of the phylum Mollusca. Explore the history of these curious sea creatures with shells.
Description_The_Search;_Avatar_The_Last_: Finally find out what happened to Zuko's and Azula's mother in this continuation of the animated series! Aang and his friends are once again saddled up on their flying bison and are hurdled straight into another emotional and hilarious adventure.
Description_Wake;_The_Hidden_History_of_: This revolutionary graphic novel uncovers the history of women who fought for their freedom on slave ships and throughout the Americas. It is a powerful exploration of resistance at the intersection of white supremacy and patriarchy.
Description_The_Magic_Fish: An emotional yet hopeful YA graphic novel about the son of Vietnamese immigrants. His parents struggle with their English, so how can Tien really talk to them about what he is going through? Will they understand when he tells them he is gay?
Description_An_Age_of_License;_A_Travelo: This comic is many things: a charming travel memoir about a trip through Europe, a lighthearted advice book for anyone with travel anxieties, and a book full of beautiful illustrations of cute kittens and delicious food.
Description_Thornhill: Mary is an orphan living at the Thornhill Institute, who tells her story in her diary. Ella, whose story is told through artful comic strips, has just moved into a street with an old, abandoned house... A dark and haunted story fit for young readers!
Description_Troglobites_Don't_Bite: What does life look like in total darkness? It's much more busy than you would think! Get to know the most fascinating cave-dwellers: from worms to snails, spiders, crustaceans, insects, fish, amphibians, and even the occasional mammalian visitor!
Description_How_Many_Castles_in_7_Days?: Stephen is a fan of castles, and he always manages to visit one wherever he travels. On his effective quest to see the most castles in only one week, Stephen compares the Czech Republic, Thuringia, and Wales in this hilarious travelogue.
Description_Dragon_Ball;Volume_1: The most energetic and funny adventure awaits young manga fans in this classic series. Join the super-strong Goku on a fantastical quest for the seven Dragon Balls that have the power to grant wishes!
Description_Jujutsu_Kaisen;Volume_1: Supernatural strength, cursed objects, and occult research are becoming daily occurrences for Yuji Itadori, the high school outcast protagonist of this popular manga series. A dark adventure for teen readers!
Description_Ranma_1/2;Volume_1: All that the teenager Ranma Saotome wants to do is train in martial arts. But a cursed spring queers his pitch, so to speak, because now, every time he is splashed with water, he changes into a girl. The beginning of a sweet and romantic manga series.
Description_Omniscient_Reader's_Viewpoin: This epic manhwa series brings a whole new twist on the reverse-isekai trope! Dokja Kim is the only reader of an obscure online novel. So when the dystopic events of the story suddenly occur in real life, he might be the only one who can still rewrite fate!
Description_Sailor_Moon;Volume_1: You know her, you love her: Usagi Tsukino might be a bit sensitive and clumsy, but when her friends are in trouble, she turns into THE magical girl and protector of all teenage girls. Join Sailor Moon and her talking cat in her sweet and romantic manga adventures!
Description_Ouran_High_School_Host_Club;: What awaits Haruhi, the poor girl at an expensive private school, when she suddenly has to work off a debt to some weird all-male after-school club? Well, first of all, she has to dress the part... A quirky and hilarious romance manga for young adults.
Description_My_Lesbian_Experience_With_L: A very candid memoir in manga format, in which the author shares her journey with mental health, sexuality, and growing up. A must-read for josei fans!
Description_Monster;Volume_1: The brilliant surgeon Dr Kenzo Tenma might be the only one who can find out the twisted motivations of a cold and calculating serial killer, in this tense and dark crime thriller in manga form.
Description_The_Rose_of_Versailles: This popular shojo manga is a historical classic featuring romance. Oscar François de Jarjayes is a nobleperson raised to fulfil the role of a man while confronted by her position in Versailles, as guard to Marie Antoinette, and ultimately joins the revolution!
Description_FAKE;Volume_1: When Ryo becomes a detective in New York, he is partnered up with the American Dee, who soon reveals his feelings for Ryo. Fake is a lighthearted romantic comedy series for all BL manga fans with 90s nostalgia.
Description_Letters_of_Bookstonbury: After her grandmother's death, a quiet librarian inherits a mobile bookshop.
