She plans to sell it — until she finds a hidden compartment beneath the floorboards, with old, unsent letters addressed to people all over town, uncovering stories of love, loss, and hope.
Description_Case_Closed;_One_and_the_Sam: When 17yo superstar detective Shinichi Kudo follows the wrong people, he's poisoned and turns back into a kid! Now as grade schooler Conan Edogawa, he still solves cases, this time on a cruise ship, in this famous whodunnit Manga series.
Description_Binti;_(Book_1): Binti is the first of the Himba to attend the intergalactic Oomza University. On her way she confronts prejudice, war, and forges a world-changing connection. A shining example of Africanfuturism and favourite with young adult readers.
Description_A_Matter_of_Oaths: When memory-wiped Rafe applies for a job on a random patrol ship, a world-changing space opera unfolds: space battles, secret identities, queer romance, and VR tech only the 80s could imagine.
Description_Ancillary_Justice;Imperial_R: What would you do if you were a giant spaceship controlling hundreds of soldiers, now betrayed and trapped in one fragile body? If you're like Breq, you'd take revenge on the colonial empire that made you.
Description_Until_I_Meet_My_Husband: Gay activist Ryousuke Nanasaki recounts the trials and tribulations of growing up and searching for love. While not always easy, he married his soulmate in the first religious same-sex wedding in Japan.
Description_How_Did_Whales_Get_So_Big?_;: Are you a child who can't stop asking questions like, "Why did my hamster eat her babies?" Try this kid-friendly encyclopaedia! Filled with stick-figure illustrations and rigorous research, this STEM book is perfect for answering even the most curious kid's questions.
Description_The_Tragical_History_of_Doct: A "brilliant" scholar makes the rather foolish decision to deal with the devil: his life in exchange for 24 years of magical prowess. But, as with other Elizabethan tragedies, there's no chance in hell this deal will end well...
Description_Waiting_for_Godot: Is there a point to waiting? Does Godot even exist? Were those two leaves there two seconds ago? Get absolutely NO answers to these existential questions (and more!) in this contemporary tragicomic play!
Description_Paradise_Kiss_;_Volume_1: From the mangaka behind Nana comes the story of the fashion atelier, Paradise Kiss. Lose yourself in the heart-wrenching romance between a fashion school student and a schoolgirl-turned-model, all in front of the stylish backdrop of 2000s Tokyo.
Description_Nana_;_Volume_1: When two young women with the same name become roommates, they also become allies in the pursuit of romance and punk rock dreams. This iconic manga series promises love, drama and a sense of fashion that can't be beat.
Description_Leave_Taking: A humorous play about a British-Caribbean mother and her two daughters transposing their Jamaican heritage in 1980's London. Leave Taking was the first play by a black female playwright to premiere at the Royal National Theatre in 1987.
Description_Etiquette_: If you want to have the perfect manners of a "well-bred" 20th-century woman, look no further than this thorough guide to politeness and civility. The devil is in the details!
Description_We_Have_Always_Lived_in_the_: Merricat's family has a dark, arsenic-laced secret — and the whole town has ostracised them for it. This unsettling mystery novel is for those who love strange and gothic stories.
Description_Nosh_for_Students;A_Fun_Stud: Finally, a cookbook written with the clueless uni student in mind! Everything is measured using a mug, and it includes helpful information like whether you should throw out those boiled eggs (hint: you probably should).
Description_The_Namesake: Born in America to Indian parents, but named for a Russian author, it's no wonder that Gogol's life is marked by identity crisis. The moving novel The Namesake presents a portrait of Gogol and his immigrant family, exploring the challenges and relationships that come with evolving cultural values.
Description_11/22/63: A time-travelling splendour from the King. What would you do if you had the opportunity to change history for the better? A chilling political journey into the United States' past, with King's usual wit.
Description_Here_Be_Dragons_;_(Welsh_Pri: The first in a trilogy of Medieval Fantasy Romance follows the tale of Joanna — the illegitimate daughter of King John — as she finds herself choosing between loyalty and love.
Description_The_Massacre_of_Mankind: Following on from events in the War of the Worlds, the world has relaxed, safe in the knowledge of how to defeat the Martian Menace. But should they be? London is a totalitarian dystopia, and nobody is as prepared as they should be...
Description_Theodora_Hendrix_and_the_Cur: Theodora lives with her spooky family, Mummy the mummy, Dracula, and the rest of the Monstrous League of Monsters. Join her as she fights to protect her family against the threat of the MLM Mansion!
Description_Flock_Horror_;_Dread_Wood_#3: Angelo and his friends are back to defeat another horror, giant vampire birds that feast on BLOOD! Will Club Loser save the day, or will the bloodsucking fiends defeat them once and for all?
Description_Jurassic_Park: IT'S JURASSIC PARK, IT'S A MASSIVE PARK! Filled with more dinosaurs and danger than you can shake a stick at. A slightly misguided scientist decides to give dinosaurs another chance, and thinks it would be great if the public could come and have a nose at them too.
Description_The_Long_Unwinding_Road_;_A_: Come with Marc P Jones as he takes you through the beautiful green hills and valleys of Wales. Discover Wales' deep majesty and ancient history, with local voices at the fore.
Description_Two_Chubby_Cubs_;_Dinner_Tim: A lively romp with the Two Chubby Cubs, married couple Paul and James, giving us plenty of filthy giggles and dinner-time inspiration
Description_The_Hairy_Bikers_;_Ultimate_: A cosy, comforting cookbook delivered by two gently hairy bikers. Filled with love and light and wholesome goodness.
Description_Wild_Abandon_;_A_Journey_to_: Jennifer Barclay picks up her backpack and explores a cluster of Greek islands on the edge of Europe. From volcanoes to beaches, she ensures no stone is left unturned, and finds a special kind of peace amongst deserted places and forgotten homes.
Description_Assassin's_Apprentice_;_The_: Fitz was born out of wedlock to the crown prince, and for that, he is hated. Join Fitz as he learns the politics and intrigue of the palace whilst being raised in the stables. Does he have a touch of the Farseer magic that is so vied for by the royal family?
Description_The_Dee_Valley_Killings: As DI Ruth Hunter deals with the disappearance of her lover, she is suddenly handed a case that is so extreme she has no doubt it is the work of a practiced killer. Together with her fiercely Welsh partner, they must identify the suspect, even if it may be close to home
Description_Zero_Days: Jack and her husband, Gabe, are the best in the business when it comes to hacking security systems and breaking into buildings. When an assignment goes wrong, Jack comes home to find Gabe dead and what can only make it worse is that there is only one suspect — her.
Description_The_Cream_Tea_Killer: Amateur sleuth Morwenna is looking forward to a bit of normality, until the local DJ she was supposed to be meeting washes up at the beach. Despite being dubbed The Cream Tea Killer, they are anything but sweet and it is up to Morwenna to unmask them.
Description_The_Southern_Book_Club's_Gui: Patricia Campbell is used to the monotony of life. Kids, husband, book club. Until one day a neighbour dies and her house is inherited by her handsome nephew who seems a bit too good to be true. He's helpful, he's kind, he's...a vampire?
Description_The_Book_of_Azrael: He was a God; she was a demon—can I make it any more obvious? A true enemies to lovers and all the way back again, with her being the morally grey naughty one for a change.
Description_Bury_Our_Bones_in_the_Midnig: A sensual slow burn about immortal love and what drives us to obsession. Dark, sapphic, beautiful vampires. Yes please.
Description_How_to_Stop_Time: Discover immortality as it has never been explored before. A historical fantasy about finding yourself, and learning how to live by the hand of Tom Hazzard, who has been alive for barely 400 years.
Description_The_Ballad_of_Jacquotte_Dela: Get ready for a pirate adventure following Jacquotte’s rise to the captaincy. Join her, her friends, and the woman she falls in love with in this epic tale of overcoming hardships and empowerment.
Description_Boys_run_the_riot,_Vol._1: Ryo, a trans teen fed up with gender rules (especially skirts), finds freedom in fashion. Teaming up with a rebellious classmate, they start a clothing brand to express themselves beyond labels. A bold, queer and stylish manga about self-acceptance and friendship.
Description_Boys_run_the_riot,_Vol._2: In volume two of this heartfelt manga, trans teen Ryo and rebel Jin have launched their DIY fashion brand Boys Run the Riot, but Ryo struggles with coming out. Can he stay true to himself and still make it in fashion?
Description_Cemetery_Boys: A trans teen determined to prove to his Latinx family that he’s a brujo tries to summon his cousin’s spirit to solve his death, but ends up instead with a ridiculously handsome ghost. A hauntingly cute paranormal romance and mystery perfect for spooky season.
Description_To_live_forever: Climb the castes, and slave your life away for a slim chance to get immortality, or live free and get legally executed at 80. Gavin Waylock’s got one goal: cheat death, dystopian-style.
Description_Declaration_of_the_Rights_of: "Woman has the right to mount the scaffold; she must equally have the right to mount the rostrum [speaking platform]." French revolutionary Olympe de Gouges flips the male-only Declaration of Human Rights, in this fearless and witty manifesto for gender equality.
Description_The_Mini_ADHD_Coach;_Tools_a: An illustrated ADHD survival guide! The Mini ADHD Coach teaches you to hack hyperfocus, beat time blindness, manage chaos, and thrive daily with humor and zero shame for your wonderfully messy brain.
Description_The_Book_of_the_City_of_Ladi: Guided by three allegorical figures, a woman builds a symbolic city with walls protecting women from slander and misogyny, celebrating their courage, wisdom, and achievements—radically ahead of its time in 15th-century Europe.
Description_The_Emperor's_New_Clothes: A vain emperor loves new clothes so much, he’ll believe anything, especially when swindlers promise him a magical outfit only the ‘wise’ can see. A hilarious tale of vanity, flattery, and adults taking themselves way too seriously.
Description_Story_of_Sinuhe: Exiled by deadly court intrigues, will Sinuhe survive foreign lands, outwit ruthless foes, and someday return to his beloved homeland? A thrilling adventure fiction that was once a bestseller in Ancient Egypt’s XXth Dynasty.
Description_An_Unkindness_of_Ghosts: On a deeply stratified spaceship, Aster uses her wit and courage to defy oppression. An afrofuturist, queer, and fiercely feminist journey.
Description_The_Red_Virgin_;_Memoirs_of_: In her memoirs, Louise Michel recounts her life as a revolutionary activist and educator, from the Paris Commune to her exile in New Caledonia. A true heroine of her time, the “Red Virgin” affirms her anarchist, feminist, and anti-colonialist commitments.
Description_The_Ugly_Duckling: Too big, oddly gray, and terribly clumsy, a poor duckling is teased by everyone. But when spring comes, he discovers he’s grown into a graceful swan. A heartwarming tale about feeling out of place, finding your wings, and realizing you were awesome all along.
Description_The_Little_Mermaid: A young mermaid saves a prince from drowning and falls hopelessly in love. She trades her voice for a chance to walk among humans. A tragic, romantic tale of longing and sacrifice, inspired by Andersen’s own unrequited love for a man.
Description_The_Nightingale: An emperor falls for a nightingale’s song, but when a flashy mechanical bird appears, everyone forgets the real nightingale, and he flies away. A poetic tale that reminds us that no technology can truly capture the beauty of nature or one's talent.
Description_Thumbelina: Born from a flower, tiny Thumbelina drifts past marriage-minded toads, moles, and bossy swallows, trying to find a home where she’s loved, not used. A sweet fairy tale about finding where you belong.
Description_Women,_Race_and_Class: In this groundbreaking essay, Angela Y. Davis explores the intersections of race, class, and gender, and how these factors shape the experiences of women in society. A foundational text in intersectional feminist theory.
Description_Romancero_Gitano: Eighteen romances (a metrical form used in Spanish poetry), portraying the pride, resistance and suffering of the Romani people, their legends and traditions, and revealing the hidden soul of Andalusia through rich symbolic and surrealist poetry.
Description_The_Code_Book_;_The_Science_: Crack codes, unravel secrets, and explore gripping historical mysteries. From ancient ciphers to World War II’s Enigma, Singh invites you to learn cryptography and test your skills with real code-breaking exercises.
Description_Design_Patterns_;_Elements_o: The classic reference for object-oriented programming, written by the legendary Gang of Four: a catalogue of reusable solutions to that solve common problems and make your code cleaner, reusable, and future-proof.
Description_The_Motivation_To_Create_;_1: A committed toolkit for staying creative while dodging burnout, AI overlords, and fascist funding cuts. Build habits, sell your art, spark change and keep your sanity (mostly) intact.
Description_All_She_Was_Worth: How desperate is a person who steals another's identity? Detective Honma searches for his nephew's missing fiancée, unravelling grim crimes to uncover the true Shoko since the dead leave traces in the living.
Description_If_the_Stars_Are_Lit: Joss Carsten is the only survivor of a starship explosion, so there's no way that Alice, her ex-wife, is truly in front of her! Yet she is, created as a sentient AI which the ship thought would help Joss survive.
Description_Point_of_Hopes;_(Astreiant_#: What happens when Rathe, a stubborn Astreiant watchman, pairs up with Philip, an intelligent (and handsome) soldier? Adventure, intrigue, a bit of romance, and the successful rescue of stolen children!
Description_Little_House_in_the_Big_Wood: Little Laura learns that each season has its work (autumn's busy harvest), and yet each season has its joy too (wintery maple syrup)! First in a series perfect for young readers, welcome to life in 1870s Wisconsin!
Description_The_Chicago_Manual_of_Style_: Are you playing pin-the-hyphen with your sentences? Currently lost in a forest of commas? Worry no more, with 200+ pages of writing rules for publications, in this vintage style guide used by academics and (some) trade publishers!
Description_The_Next_100_Years;_A_Foreca: "Russia and China collapse in the early 2020s, Japan experiences a resurgence to power, and 2050 sees WWIII happening. Is this a parallel world? Nope! It's (so far) an out-of-date political forecast!"
Description_The_Ghost_Map;_A_Street,_a_C: Two different paths converge, and between John Snow (physician) and Henry Whitehead (reverend), the source of London's 1854 cholera outbreak is chased down to a single public water pump on Broad Street.
Description_Where_the_Sidewalk_Ends: With poems about hooks (don't scratch) and snakes (don't stretch). Sisters for sales and Peggy Ann, who ails. Boars, and crocs, and hats (no clocks?). Come for a giggle, just laugh aloud, and try not to wriggle!
Description_Watership_Down: A journey of rabbits to find a new home, where they'll have to outwit enemies, "allies," and what seems to be every single one of the Prince's Thousand Enemies, for even when you reach the end, you find it's not that simple.
Description_Say_Cheese_and_Die!;_Goosebu: Chills, thrills, and plenty of goosebumps! Read these spine-tingling horror books where nothing is quite like it seems, and be careful! There are demonic cameras, Monster Blood (don't swallow), and wishes you can't take back.
Description_The_Mousetrap_and_Other_Play: A locked room mystery in a snowbound bed and breakfast by The Queen of Crime. The Mousetrap opened at Theatre Royal in Nottingham, England on October 6, 1952. The play met with such success it didn’t leave the stage in 70 years, becoming history’s longest running play.
Description_The_Representative_Plays_of_: A selection of lesser-known plays from the playwright most famous for Peter Pan. This collection features Quality Street, The Admirable Crichton, What Every Woman Knows, Dear Brutus, The Twelve-Pound Look, and The Old Lady Shows Her Metals.
Description_The_Glass_Menagerie: If you think your family life is dramatic, this story may cast things in a new light. This tense play is about a son and daughter living with their fragile mother’s mental illness and broken dreams. Talk about mama drama!
Description_A_Year_in_Tokyo;An_Illustrat: Australian content creator and author Christy Ann Jones shares how to appreciate the city of Ginko leaves in this beautifully illustrated guide. A sketchy internship, translation mishaps, and culture shock, balanced by the best chicken katsu and the cutest bookshops!
Description_Elsewhere;One_Woman,_One_Ruc: Rosita reflects on the life-changing experiences and people she met on nine journeys, from a chaotic bus ride in Pakistan to a healing swim in Bali, carrying only a rucksack and a diary. An emotion-filled collection of essays, both thrilling and heartbreaking.
Description_84,_Charing_Cross_Road: An epistolary memoir about a friendship that develops over a shared love of books. A lighthearted, humorous collection of letters between a bookseller in London and a writer in New York City, desperate to fill gaps in her collection.
Description_Ship_of_Magic;Liveship_Trade: Only a liveship carved from wizardwood can trade on the deadly waters of the Rain Wild. Althea wants nothing more than to captain her own. Shrewd negotiations, betrayals, and wondrous discoveries await! One of two entry points to a 16-book series.
Description_Home_Before_Dark: Her father's last words were: “Stay away from the house, it’s not safe for you.” Maggie gives her word. But later, she discovers she's inherited the spooky house that made her father famous. Can't hurt to visit... right? A horror/thriller with a book-within-a-book format.
Description_Dream_First,_Details_Later;H: Helpful advice for getting your dream off the ground, running a business, and running with the right people, served up in a colorfully designed book from chef/entrepreneur Ellen Bennett.
Description_The_Tenant_of_Wildfell_Hall: Gilbert is curious about Helen, the quiet woman who moved into Wildfell Hall with her young son. A gothic romance novel with feminist themes. So ahead of its time that Anne's sister Charlotte hid it from publishers until after Anne's death.
Description_North_and_South: The Industrial Revolution in England! Social Justice! Romance? Margaret and John's motivations clash over the working conditions in a dangerous cotton mill. Victorian literature has never seen more productive yearning.
Description_Wide_Sky,_Narrow_Path;A_View: A poetic memoir about the author's journey through-hiking the Appalachian Trail from Georgia to Maine. Courtney shares the harsh realities and stunning beauty of the trail alongside her intimate reflections on spirituality.
Description_Mr._Penumbra's_24-Hour_Books: Clay has some digital marketing experience. So when he's hired on the night shift at Mr Penumbra's, he’s puzzled about why it's still in business. Most customers only borrow books from the highest shelves in the store. A fantastical quest story set in a San Francisco bookstore!
Description_On_Earth_as_It_Is_on_Televis: When the aliens suddenly turn around, seemingly without any message of threat or peace, Earth doesn’t really know how to move on. Some of us made too many end-of-the-world changes to go back. Extraterrestrial and existential crises abound.
Description_A_Study_in_Charlotte;Charlot: Jamie Watson has admired the coldly intellectual Charlotte Holmes… from a distance. But when another boarding school student dies in a manner identical to a Sherlock Holmes story, the young adult descendants of Holmes and Watson must team up to find the killer.
Description_Who_Could_That_Be_at_This_Ho: Readers are discouraged from reading this book about a pre-teen training as a secret agent in a strange town. It would also be better if you avoid drinking coffee and listening to classical jazz while doing so. Book one of a series better left unpublished.
Description_Escape_from_Mr._Lemoncello's: Kyle Keeley never met a puzzle he didn't like. So he’s thrilled when a famous game maker invites him and 12 other kids to an overnight lock-in, the grand opening of the town library. In the morning, the doors are still locked. Solve the puzzles and escape the library!
Description_This_Book_Will_Bury_Me: After her father's death, Janeway finds a vehicle for her grief and unanswered questions: true crime discussion boards. She'll do anything to chase down new leads on a cold case, but her new online friends are hiding dark secrets of their own. An unputdownable thriller!
Description_The_Maid;Molly_the_Maid_#1: The first book in a mystery series with a lovable, neurospicy protagonist at its heart. Molly loves her job cleaning rooms at the Regency Grand Hotel, but her gullibility makes her both an unreliable narrator and the perfect suspect for a murder mystery!
Description_The_Death_of_Mrs._Westaway: Hal's faking it, but barely making it as a fortune teller. When she receives an invitation to the will-reading of a stranger, she assumes the identity of the addressee to see if her fate can change. But greater threats await. A gothic thriller, perfect for a rainy day!
Description_Welcome_to_the_Hyunam-Dong_B: She doesn't have many customers, but Yeongju hopes to keep her bookshop open just a little longer. She hires a barista, invites guest speakers, and starts a book club. A cosy Korean bestseller about savouring the simple joys in life over chasing productivity.
Description_The_Vanishing_Stair;Truly_De: After the murder last year, Stevie's parents don't want her at Ellingham Academy. But Stevie will do anything to return, even make a deal with a shady politician. Anything to get back to her friends, the boy she kissed, and her work on the Truly Devious case!
Description_The_Examiner: The Royal Hastings University Multimedia Art course: One Instructor, Six Students, One Murder. This dark academia crime story puts you in the chair of the examiner, with access to all the emails, project reports, chat threads, and other documents from the class!
Description_The_Lighthouse_Mystery;The_B: Henry, Jessie, Violet, and Benny's days in a boxcar are behind them. Now they travel the world, solving mysteries nobody wanted their help with! This summer, the siblings are asleep in a lighthouse when their dog Watch wakes them, barking at something unseen.
Description_Maisie_Dobbs;_Book_1: Housemaid, college student, frontline nurse. Maisie has honed her observation skills in many settings, so after the War, she decides to become a private investigator. Her first assignment seems like a simple case of infidelity, but it hides a bigger conspiracy.
Description_The_Unusual_Suspects;The_Sis: Granny Relda tells Sabrina and Daphne the truth about their legacy. That classic book of fairytales? It's actually a casebook of magical crimes. Oh, and their new school in Ferryport Landing may have monsters. The second volume in a series of fractured fairy tales.
Description_The_Mysterious_Benedict_Soci: Four children pass a series of curious tests to qualify for an undercover operation. Their mission: find out what's happening at the Learning Institute for the Very Enlightened. Contains buckets of friendship, weird inventions, and adventure!
38 tales from an American writer famous for surprise endings! Will Porter began writing short stories from prison in 1898. He later changed his name and started fresh in New York City. He wrote over 600 stories in his lifetime. Some aged better than others.
Description_Europe_Through_the_Back_Door: Catch yourself thinking, "I could live here," on nearly every trip? Make the most out of your time in Europe by acting like you already do. Let TV-famous travel guide Rick Steves teach you how to connect with locals, avoid scams, and have a stress-free trip.
Description_All_Systems_Red;The_Murderbo: Meet Murderbot, a SecUnit who recently hacked their governor chip. Too bad it keeps getting sent on planetary bodyguard contracts for the shady Company! All this android wants is space to have an existential crisis and binge-watch their favourite program.
Description_War_and_Peace: A hefty chonk indeed. A famous historical novel with a meandering plot between — you guessed it: war and peace. As much about choosing the right life partner as it is about the Napoleonic Wars.
Description_The_Unselected_Journals_of_E: Emma chronicles her romantic life at Lapis Lazuli House in a series of witty novellas that transport the reader to London, 1883. Your journal probably doesn't have a plot line, and neither does Emma's.
Description_Paradise_Lost: A famously epic poem retelling the Christian creation and fall story. Betrayal, revenge, and a battle for ultimate dominance. In the beginning, there was drama!
Description_Antony_and_Cleopatra: A tragic play set during the founding of the Roman Empire in 30 BC. Bask in the hot mess of a relationship between Egyptian Queen Cleopatra and Roman General Mark Antony.
Description_The_Merry_Adventures_of_Robi: Follow the adventures of the merry bandit who robbed from the rich to give to the poor. Pyle, an American illustrator, wrote this version of the legend especially for children, and this edition features his humorous illustrations.
Description_The_Hunchback_of_Notre-Dame: A gothic romance set in the dark and troubling streets of medieval Paris. Ring any bells? Each chapter is told by a different unlikeable character, and none of them are gargoyles, making this novel far more depressing than its animated adaptation.
Description_Ella_Enchanted: You don't want Lucinda on your guest list. That fairy's magical 'gifts' don't come with a receipt! As she grew, Ella found her own ways to cope with her curse of obedience, but she'll need to go on a quest to break it. A romantic, empowering Cinderella story.
Description_East_of_Eden: A retelling of Genesis set on California farmland in 1865. This complex novel centres on the timeless struggles of two families, exploring themes of rivalry, identity, and love.
Description_On_the_Banks_of_Plum_Creek;(: Laura and her family leave their house on the prairie for Plum Creek in Minnesota. During the day, Laura and Mary go to school, do chores, and go fishing. At night, Pa's fiddle sings them to sleep. Fourth in a classic series perfect for little pioneers!
Description_The_Dragonet_Prophecy;Wings_: A dark and character-driven YA series set in a world where dragons endlessly fight over treasure. Prophecy foretells that the sacrifice of a young dragon will end the war for good… But what if this promised dragon doesn't particularly want to fulfil their destiny?
Description_The_Green_Ember;_Book_1: Forced to flee their home, siblings Heather and Picket come to a hidden refuge where each rabbit trains their gifts to bring about a Mended Wood. Kids will love this series with its brave characters and themes of found family. Rabbits with swords!
Description_A_Smile_in_the_Mind: A collection of the best examples of graphic design wit. This book features the work of more than 300 designers who created wink-worthy logos, ads, and packaging that invite the viewer inside the joke, with explanations about the brain science that makes them tick.
Description_Art_of_the_Modern_Movie_Post: A lovely collection of over 1,500 vintage film posters, perfect for any film buff, poster-collector, or owner of a coffee table.
Description_The_Unexpected_Mrs._Pollifax: Emily Pollifax is a widowed empty-nester who's always dreamt of becoming a spy. So at 60 years of age, she leaves her tiny apartment in New Jersey to visit Washington, and asks politely if the CIA will have her. Thus begins a hilarious and lighthearted mystery series!
Description_The_Maltese_Falcon: Private Eye Sam Spade is visited by a mysterious client who needs him to find her sister. She's lying. It's all about a golden bird! This classic crime novel also was also a smashing success with its 1941 film noir adaptation starring Humphrey Bogart.
Description_The_Body_in_the_Library;Miss: The body of a young woman is found in the library at the Bantry estate. Before the police question the neighbours, Mrs Bantry suggests they consult Miss Marple, a silver-haired woman with a keen ear for village gossip and a keen eye for human nature.
Description_A_Murder_is_Announced;Miss_M: A newspaper ad extends an open invitation to a murder mystery party at the home of Letitia Blacklock. But when the lights go out, a real murder takes place. Can Miss Marple find the killer? A classic whodunnit with a delicious plot twist that will make you RSVP 'Yes!'
Description_What_You’re_Looking_For_is_i: A cosy novel about patrons who visit a library in Tokyo with their questions.This Japanese bestseller encourages the reader to identify what they're looking for, and savour the magical possibilities in the lives they touch and the pages they turn. Repetitive, calming, and sweet.
Description_The_Field_Guide;The_Spiderwi: When Jared, Simon, and Mallory dust off a field guide to the hidden world of faerie, the siblings learn the dangerous, fantastical creatures are a little too close to their new home. Book one of a magical children's series.
Description_The_Library_Book: A journalist's engaging investigation into the 1986 fire at the Los Angeles Public Library. Part true-crime story, part essay on what libraries mean to us, and why the burning of books or libraries is so devastating.
Description_Sorcery_of_Thorns;_Book_1: Elisabeth grew up in a library of dangerous books. When the most dangerous grimoire of them all is unleashed, she's the prime suspect. But she suspects sorcerer Nathaniel Thorn is the real culprit. A darkly magical YA novel with Howls Moving Castle vibes.
Description_We_Solve_Murders;_Book_1: Amy is working as a bodyguard for a famous author on her private island when a body washes onshore. Thankfully, her father-in-law, Steve, is a retired police officer with plenty of free time on his hands! The first case in a series for this dynamic duo.
Description_The_Bullet_That_Missed;A_Thu: Another week at Cooper's Chase retirement village, another cold case for Joyce, Elizabeth, Ibrahim, and Ron to solve. A stranger from Elizabeth's past arrives to threaten her, but the Thursday Murder Club always keep their confidences and protects their own!
Description_Listen_for_the_Lie: Lucy doesn't want to be on a podcast about her best friend's murder. Her memory from that night is sketchy at best, and the town has already decided who's guilty. But true crime podcaster Ben is both persistent and attractive. Unputdownable and spicy!
Description_Winnie_The_Pooh;The_Complete: Ten stories featuring a small bear and his friendly neighbours in the Hundred Acre Wood: Pooh, Piglet, Rabbit, Eeyore, Owl, Kanga, Little Roo, and Christopher Robin. Complete with full-colour illustrations, sure to Tigger, I mean trigger your nostalgia.
Description_Five_Little_Peppers_and_How_: A cosy classic about five children and their mother, living in a little brown house, learning to be helpful and create their own happiness in lean times. Who knew baked goods and surprise visits could bring so much joy?
Description_Pollyanna;_Book_1: A little orphan girl with toxic positivity moves in with her cold matronly Aunt, and winds up changing the entire mood of their small town in Vermont. A classic book that inspired hundreds of children to start ‘gladness clubs’ (Yes, really).
Description_Caps_for_Sale;_A_Tale_of_a_P: A classic picture book about the dangers of taking naps under trees filled with monkeys. Hilarious and repetitive, what every child wants.
Description_Eloise;A_Book_for_Precocious: A spoiled little girl runs wild at New York City's famous Plaza Hotel. She's six years-old, so she'll insist on telling you how things work here. Parents might classify this as a horror novel, but you'll love the clever illustrations.
Description_How_Winston_Delivered_Christ: A brave little mouse sets off on a quest to deliver a lost letter to Father Christmas on Christmas Eve. This picture book is designed to be read as an Advent calendar, and includes activities for children impatiently counting down the days till Christmas.
Description_The_Frozen_River: As a midwife, Martha Ballard carefully records births, deaths, and any crimes in their small town of Hallowell, Maine. In 1789, Martha's diary becomes evidence in a trial that divides her community. A thrilling mystery based on a true story. Contains mature themes.
Description_The_Hobbit;The_Lord_of_the_R: You never know what'll happen when you step outside your front door. Especially if a wizard left his mark on said door. Bilbo leaves his creature comforts behind to seek adventure with a company of dwarves, and winds up bringing home the worst souvenir possible.
Description_Tuck_Everlasting: When Winnie is given the choice to drink water that grants eternal youth, the Tucks help her wrestle with a decision bigger than her ten years can handle. A classic middle-grade novel with beautiful prose and heartbreaking moments. Keep tissues nearby!
Description_The_Blue_Castle: When 29-year-old Valancy gets bad news from her doctor, she decides she’s ready to live. She’s done letting her family dictate how she spends her days, and she offers friendship to the townsfolk they despise. A romantic and hopeful novel about second chances.
Description_The_Enchanted_Castle: Gerald, Cathy and Jimmy's game of pretend begins quite ordinarily, but then turns frighteningly real. An enchanted garden, a sleeping princess, an invisibility ring, a pile of coats with its own personality, all alive with magic in this charming children's tale.
Description_Wrong_Place_Wrong_Time: Jen saw her son murder a stranger, right outside their home. But when she wakes the next morning, it's yesterday. She has the time to change what happened. Each time she falls asleep, she wakes deeper in the past. A thriller with a shocking twist!
Description_Gathering_Moss;A_Natural_and: A collection of essays about a vital, yet overlooked, piece of natural history. A scientist, mother, teacher, and writer of Native American heritage, Kimmerer explains the science behind mosses and how it relates to ways of living. A thoughtful read for all ages!
Description_Mad_About_You: Harriet breaks up with her long-term boyfriend and moves into a rented flat. Turns out she's already met her new roommate: he left his fiancée on their wedding day, and she was the photographer. A slow-burn romance with more emotional layers than baklava!
Description_True_Crime_Story: In 2011, 19-year-old Zoe Nolan left a party at her flat and disappeared. Seven years later, writer Evelyn Mitchell is investigating the missing girl. Troubled by her findings, Evelyn consults Knox, a crime writer. A thriller so stacked with evidence, it feels real.
Description_Chocolat;__Book_1: Vianne’s new chocolaterie is a refuge for the overlooked townspeople of Lansquenet. Customers are given a mug of bittersweet hot chocolate, a sympathetic ear, and just a touch of magic–much to the disapproval of the local priest.
Description_The_Secret_Garden;A_Graphic_: When Mary Lennox arrives at her Uncle Craven's manor on the Yorkshire moors, she's very unhappy. There are too many rules for a ten-year-old girl in this house. But she's heard rumours of a secret garden... Could it be a place to call her own?
Description_The_Story_Girl;_Book_1: Fourteen-year-old Sara Stanley is a born storyteller. Both kids and grown-ups are captivated by her tales. Bev and his younger brother Felix spend a summer full of stories with their new friend Sara, hanging on her every word.
Description_Belinda: Belinda has aspirations beyond London's social season. Amongst the heroine's witty observations of eighteenth-century society, this novel also touches on the challenging issues of feminism, racism, and obsession. One of Jane Austen's favourite books!
Description_A_Thousand_Feasts;_Small_Mom: What if you could preserve the tiniest of moments before they are gone forever? The scent of a meal, the feel of a specific day. An essay collection of brief yet beautiful experiences from the author's travels, captured in prose like a leaf in amber.
Description_Eugene_Onegin: Tatyana loves Eugene. Eugene thinks she's boring. Later, he wishes he had acted differently. A suspenseful Russian novel in verse with a large cast of characters and plenty of philosophy to chew on!
Description_Anna_Karenina: An emotionally-charged Russian novel about love triangles, affairs, and farming. Wish you could be the hero of your own tragic story? Ride a sad train with Anna Karenina.
Description_Bird_by_Bird;Some_Instructio: The most difficult part of writing is just getting started! Author Anne Lamott gently guides the aspirational writer through each step of the writing journey. Learn how to observe, reflect, and give yourself plenty of grace through the process!
Description_Why_I_Am_Not_Going_to_Buy_a_: Do I wish to keep up with the times? No. My wish simply is to live my life as fully as I can.' A collection of essays explaining this great American novelist's reluctance to embrace a life of convenience and productivity.
Description_Jayber_Crow;Port_William_#7: Jayber drops out of school and returns to his hometown, where he finds a clearer picture of life's miracles in his barbershop chair than in a thousand books. A touching and humorous novel set in 1932, following the loveable residents of Port William, Kentucky.
Description_And_The_World_Spins_Anyway: In the author's debut collection of poetry and short stories, she invites readers to take a step away from social media and feel a little less alone in this chaotic, beautiful world. A refreshing and relatable read.
Description_The_Unseen_World: Twelve-year-old Ada Sibelius is a shy prodigy who follows her father to work in his computer lab every day. When her father's memory fails, adult Ada seeks answers by venturing into the virtual world herself. An emotional mystery novel with just a touch of sci-fi.
Description_We_Live_Here_Now: Emily and Freddie are a couple divided by their secrets. Although Emily is still experiencing paranoia post-surgery, she's fairly certain their new house, Larkin Lodge, is haunted. A gothic horror/domestic thriller with a surprising and philosophical twist!
Description_Hamnet: Stratford-upon-Avon, 1596 – A marriage is on the rocks, and a sudden illness threatens the life of a child. A short, tragic, and intricate novel about the familial inspiration behind one of the world’s most famous plays. It never mentions the playwright by name!
Description_Hello_Lighthouse_: A Caldecott Award Winning picture book. Say hello to a lighthouse keeper and his wife, guarding the coast through days of stormy waves and sunny skies, waiting for the arrival of their child. At the end, wave goodbye to the lighthouse on their return to the mainland.
Description_A_Place_to_Hang_the_Moon: William, Edmund, and Anna need a guardian, so they slip into a crowd of evacuating London children, hoping to find a home. Nora, a friendly librarian, is the target of local gossip because of her German husband. But she has plenty of books, and makes a mean hot cocoa!
Description_There's_A_Ghost_In_This_Hous: Tour a spooky little house with a friendly little ghost! This creatively printed children's book alternates from grayscale illustrations to transparent vellum pages, so the pale ghost appears to float through the pages.
Description_Three_Bags_Full;Sheep_Detect: A humorous murder mystery set on a hillside near Glennkill, Ireland. A flock of sheep are outraged that someone got away with murdering their shepherd, George. Can this eclectic cast of sheep detectives figure out who killed him? An absolutely baaa-tty first book.
Description_The_Man_Who_Was_Thursday: A secret society, hell-bent on world domination, led by seven figures known only by days of the week. This comedic mystery follows a Scotland Yard detective hoping to dismantle the institution from the inside. His code name? Thursday.
Description_Selected_Stories_of_Anton_Ch: 30 stories from the Russian writer and playwright, famous for his painterly prose and use of foreshadowing. This collection features The Huntsman, A Boring Story, The Lady with the Little Dog (a crowd-pleaser), and Chekhov's personal favourite, The Student.
Description_The_Moorland_Cottage: Maggie suffers under the oppressive needs of her bitter mother and selfish brother. When a neighbouring family offers her a glimpse of the warmth she’s never known, she must choose between her burden of responsibility to her family and the call of true love.
Description_Swann's_Way;In_Search_of_Los: A bite of cookie triggers the narrator's slow release of memories: his neighbour's daily walks, and his growing love for Swann's daughter, Gilberte. Proust liked writing in bed. No shame if his book puts you to sleep. Volume one of the world's longest novel.
Description_Shady_Hollow;A_Shady_Hollow_: Today's Headline: Murder in Shady Hollow! Reporter Vera Vixen just moved to this cosy town of neighbourly creatures, but the fox immediately employs her journalistic skills to track down leads. She'll have to be careful, not every animal wants her to solve this mystery!
Description_The_Sherlockian: The world's foremost Arthur Conan Doyle scholar is dead. In his possession was a diary detailing what happened in the 8-year gap when the author wasn't publishing Sherlock Holmes stories. Harold, a literary researcher, must employ Holmes’ methods to find the killer!
Description_The_Unmaking_of_June_Farrow: Eventually, each Farrow woman begins to see, hear, and smell things that aren’t there, slowly unravelling their grip on reality. June is starting to see the signs. A mysterious novel about the doors we choose, and how those choices shape who we become and who we love.
Description_Everyone_in_My_Family_Has_Ki: Shortly after Ernest arrives at a secluded ski lodge for the Cunningham family reunion, a body is found in the snow. Ernie writes how-to books for mystery writers. He knows the best rules, formulas, and tropes. But he's never been this close to this many suspects!
Description_The_Last_Story_of_Mina_Lee: When 26-year-old Margot finds her mother's body in her Koreatown apartment, ruled a death by suspicious circumstances, she starts investigating for herself. A novel told in dual timeline, we also follow Mina's perspective during her first year in Los Angeles.
Description_Greenglass_House;(Book_1): Milo has plans to exclusively munch on cookies and read books during his winter holidays. But thanks to a snowstorm, his parents' inn fills with guests, all strangely invested in the story of their house. A locked room mystery and a treasure hunt, with a surprise twist!
Description_The_Invention_of_Hugo_Cabret: A mysterious tale about a young boy living in a Paris train station. With sparse pages of text, the story is told mostly through black-and-white illustrations, theatrically revealing tiny details of each scene–and Hugo's secret invention–one frame at a time.
Description_Truly_Devious;_Book_1: Stevie Bell’s winning scholarship essay was about her hopes to solve Ellingham Academy's historically cold murder case. But in the present day, a new body is added to the killer's tally. Steve can handle being a detective, a student, and a good friend, right?
Description_Five_Survive: Red and her five friends are headed for Spring Break at the beach. But when their RV breaks down, the young adults are stranded. A killer plans to silence one of their group. Can they find out who they want before the night takes them all?
Description_Pygmalion: Professor Henry Higgins bets he can coach a socially awkward flower seller into passing as an aristocratic lady. He doesn't expect to fall in love with her. This humorous play pokes fun at classism in the 20th century, and was later adapted as the musical My Fair Lady.
Description_The_Illustrated_Dust_Jacket,: In this collection of cover art, you'll see the historical evolution of style and intention in book jacket design: From practical tool to key marketing element. Go ahead and judge books by their covers!
Description_Ficciones: 17 masterful short stories from the Argentinian writer and poet, famous for his maze-like prose. Fantastical, intellectual, and bizarre. This selection includes The Library of Babel, The Circular Ruins, and The God of the Labyrinth.
Description_Infinite_Jest: A darkly comedic novel about addiction, depression, and tennis. The large number of pages and unlikeable characters make it a veritable mountain-climb of a read. You might finish it, it might finish you. Love or hate this book, you'll be in good company!
Description_Blurb_Your_Enthusiasm;A_Crac: You pick up a book. What next? Maybe you read the hook on the back cover, the flaps, and the glowing blurbs authors give one another 'Astonishing!'... Did they even read it? Learn the humour and history behind the text outside of books! As meta as it gets.
Description_How_to_Say_Babylon: Safiya's father used fear and anger to control the women in his family, forbidding Western (Babylon) influences. But her mother silently handed her books. Education gave Safiya a voice, and this feminist memoir stands as proof of her power in its lyrical, poetic prose.
Description_The_Island_of_Missing_Trees: A tale of forbidden love and common roots set on the divided island of Cyprus in 1974. This story is told through multiple perspectives, shifting time, place, and species. The main narrator is a fig tree!
Description_The_Wind_In_The_Willows: This delightfully illustrated children’s book contains the misadventures of four well-intentioned friends: Mole, Badger, Rat, and every car salesman's dream, the out-of-control Mr Toad.
Description_The_Princess_Bride: This fantasy story contains: battles of wit, feats of strength, rodents of unusual size, sword fights of revenge, and the truest of true love, all saturated with inconceivable levels of satire.
Description_The_Mystery_of_the_Blue_Trai: Before boarding a luxury train to Nice, detective Hercule Poirot befriends Ruth, a troubled American heiress. By journey's end, his new friend has been murdered. It would seem the usefulness of the little grey cells is not exclusive to the Orient Express, eh?
Description_The_Trumpet_of_the_Swan: Louis is the trumpeter swan who can't. He wants desperately to call out to his crush, Serena, but he can't make a sound. But as this colorful children's book teaches, sometimes you just need a little creativity to express yourself!
Description_Redwall;_Book_1: Welcome to Redwall– An abbey that offers the sanctuary of good food, warm fires, and brave tales. This world is not without its dangers, but if a humble mouse can claim a fabled sword, they might just go down in song and legend!
Description_Olivetti: When its human family is in crisis, a vintage typewriter breaks the rules to communicate what they most need to remember. A heartfelt and beautiful middle-grade book!
Description_This_Golden_State: Seventeen year-old Poppy has never felt settled. Her family is always moving, always 'for their safety.' But she likes her new school and friends in California, and needs to know why it could all disappear. A mysterious YA novel about identity, belonging, and love.
Description_Dreamer's_Pool;_Blackthorn_&: Two new friends start new lives after a magical escape. Blackthorn is a healer, Grim does physical labor. The duo's work on a local crime draws the Prince's attention. He needs their help with a problem of his own. A fantasy trilogy with slow-burn romance!
Description_Far_from_the_Madding_Crowd: Bathsheba Everdene thinks she's all that. Three men are reluctant to contradict her and eager to win her affections. A foggy, moody novel in a provincial setting with tragic plot twists and beautiful nature writing.
Description_A_Child's_Garden_of_Verses: A collection of sixty-six poems for imaginative children, accompanied by the gentle watercolour illustrations of Tasha Tudor.
Description_Five_Children_and_It;Five_Ch: One summer at the beach, five siblings discover a Psammead, a fantastical creature who grants each of them a wish. Each wish's impact will only last for one day, which is for the best, given the inevitable need for damage control.
Description_Anxious_People: An apartment showing becomes a hostage situation when a bank robber walks in. The catch: no one knows their identity! As the pressure builds, a collection of perfect strangers confess their deepest fears in this tender, mysterious, and funny story.
Description_The_Last_Time_I_Lied: Emma remembers the night her cabin mates snuck out... Some of it. The memory gaps still haunt her. Fifteen years later, she reluctantly returns to camp Nightingale, and it feels like someone's waiting for her to break. A chilling and twisty YA thriller!
Description_The_Housekeeper_and_the_Prof: A math professor with short-term memory loss develops a friendship with his housekeeper and her son. As his health fails, he begins to attach mathematical formulae to the minute details of their lives. An emotional and reflective novel.
Description_The_Forgotten_Beasts_of_Eld: Sybel's closest friends are magical animals. She's more than content to avoid the war brewing in neighboring kingdoms. But when a soldier brings a human baby into her fantastical menagerie for safekeeping, her safe little world will never be the same.
Description_The_Pallbearers_Club: He met her in the 1980s when he was seventeen and deeply uncool. She introduced him to the world of punk rock and challenged his disbelief in vampires. A slowly-building horror novel with critical annotations courtesy of its femme fatale.
Description_Theft_of_Swords;_Ryria_Revel: Royce and Hadrian are thieves-for-hire who take only the most difficult jobs. On their latest heist, the two buddies are roped into a greater conspiracy that could impact the future of the entire kingdom. Friendship and betrayal, myths and legends await!
Description_Little_Lord_Fauntleroy: Cedric, a middle-class American boy, learns he's heir to an English earldom. In the 1880s, this book popularised a trend in boys' fashion and set a legal precedent when the author insisted on compensation for theatrical adaptations of her work! Show me the money!
Description_The_Turn_of_the_Screw: A young governess slowly realises the two children under her care are the target of the creepy ghosts who haunt the estate. The troubling part is that Flora and Miles seem perfectly fine with it. Worst job ever.
Description_Lady_Audley's_Secret: A scandalous domestic thriller complete with a twisty murder mystery, and a layered anti-heroine. Surprisingly feminist for the Victorian era!
Description_Bleak_House: A layered story about injustice and generosity, set amid the chaotic legal system of 19th-century London. The fortunes of many lie in the outcome of a twelve-year legal dispute. While lawyers quibble, drama, mystery, and tragedy unfold in the characters' daily lives.
Description_A_Cook's_Tour;Global_Adventu: Experience global culinary adventures with beloved chef Anthony Bourdain! A savoury travel memoir in search of the perfect meal.
Description_Death_in_Yellowstone;Acciden: Grizzly bear attacks, hot springs, and avalanches, oh my! Cautionary tales about what not to do in one of America's wildest national parks.
Description_Three_Men_in_a_Boat;Three_Me: Three men (and a dog) decide to escape the drudgery of their jobs and boat down the Thames in this early example of work life balance. Case in point: the author started to write a travel guide, but gave the world this humorous novel instead!
Description_The_Essential_Calvin_and_Hob: Follow the adventures of Calvin and Hobbes, his come-to-life stuffed tiger. From dangerous wagon rides to armies of snowmen, this dynamic duo could care less what girls or adults think of their imaginative pursuits. A graphic novel both hilarious and heartwarming.
Description_The_Phantom_of_the_Opera: The Phantom holds a reign of terror over the Paris Opera House. He has a special place in his heart for Christine Daaé, the singer he's trained while masquerading as an angel of music. And he's easily jealous. This classic is way more murder-y than the musical.
Description_The_Miracle_Worker;_A_Play: "When we do the best we can, we never know what miracle is wrought in our life, or in the life of another." This semi-biographical play tells the story of the life-altering friendship between Helen Keller and her teacher, Annie Sullivan.
Description_Breakfast_at_Tiffany's: Holly Golightly may seem shallow and carefree, with her many suitors and piles of gifts. But as the young writer gets to know her–first out of curiosity, then attraction–he realises she's not cheap, she's priceless.
Description_Devotions;_The_Selected_Poem: If you find yourself thinking about the short-lived nature of changing seasons, wishing you could sit by a stream and see what animals come to visit, or needing to slow down and just be, you'll find a companion in the poet Mary Oliver.
Description_The_Adventures_of_Huckleberr: Mark Twain shows us the hypocrisy of 19th century Mississippi through the dawning understanding of a young boy's conscience. From the evils of slavery to toxic masculinity, Huck has to reckon with what he sees and decide for himself. And it takes him a while...
Description_Virgil_Wander: A tragic accident leaves Virgil with no memories. His small Midwestern town, his language, everything must be relearned with the help of a community facing its own set of tragedies. An emotional, character-driven novel that features magical realism.
Description_Beartown;__Book_1: Beartown's last ember of hope lies in the success of its youth hockey league. When a scandal breaks involving the star player and the manager's daughter, each town member must choose whether they're on the side of justice, or the dream of a chance at finally winning.
Description_Blue_Highways;_The_Travel_Tr: William set off on what would become a 13,000 mile journey by van, visiting the most overlooked small towns in America. His series of travel memoirs prove that it's not where you go, it's who you meet! Blue highways are back roads.
Description_Maybe_You_Should_Talk_to_Som: Lori Gottlieb is a therapist who needs therapy. As she tells the stories of her (nameless) patients, she recognises themes in common with her own self-talk. A funny and hopeful memoir about our shared desires and capacity for change.
Description_I_Capture_the_Castle: Seventeen year-old Cassandra lives in the remnants of a castle with her eccentric family. Her 1934 journal is going strong, but her father's latest book is a work-in-procrastination, so money is tight. Maybe romance and a strategic prank can change their fates!
Description_Interior_Chinatown: Willis has the opposite of main character energy. But whenever he walks into the Golden Palace restaurant, he's on the set of Black and White, a cop show that's somehow always in production. This novel is a creative look at cultural tropes and Asian stereotypes.
Description_Warcross;_Book_1: Emika Chen is a hacker paid to track players making illegal bets inside the Warcross game. When she glitches into the game herself for some extra cash, the game's creator, Hideo Tanaka, decides she'll make the perfect spy. An immersive YA series!
Description_Moonwalking_with_Einstein;Th: Journalist Joshua Foer spent a year training to improve his memory with the world's top experts, eventually entering–and winning!–the US Memory Competition. This book will teach you how he did it, so you can remember what this book was about!
Description_Women_Travel_Solo;30_Inspiri: Solo travel can be intimidating! This anthology will encourage you to book that trip. Read about the experiences and personal revelations of 30 female solo travelers, complete with scenic photographs to encourage your wanderlust.
Description_Baking_with_Kim-Joy;Cute_and: 40 recipes from the sunshine-filled Great British Bake Off finalist. If your desserts don't make your friends squeal with delight, are they even treats? This cookbook includes colourful instructions for making llama cookies, panda-madeleines, and choux bun turtles.
Description_Brown_Girl_Dreaming: An award-winning memoir-in-verse. Jacqueline uses poetry to share what it was like growing up Black during the 1960s-1970s in South Carolina and New York, including the growing joy she found in writing. A powerful, yet approachable book for middle-grade readers.
Description_Sir_Gawain_and_the_Green_Kni: In this epic 14th-century poem, a green knight on a green horse (do they eat green eggs and ham?) arrives at Camelot on Yuletide. He throws his glove, an open challenge to King Arthur's knights. Sir Gawain accepts the wager, but he has no clue what he’s in for!
Description_I_Know_Why_the_Caged_Bird_Si: Maya's childhood was one of prejudice, neglect, and violence. Adult Maya finds the keys to her cage of trauma through self-love, escaping to the embrace of good books and kind people. A tragic and inspiring autobiography from a resilient Black poet.
Description_The_Woman_in_Cabin_10;Lo_Bla: A week on an über luxury yacht? Yes, please. Travel journalist Lo witnesses a woman thrown overboard, but frustratingly, no one believes she's telling the truth. A suspenseful thriller with a cast of characters that rivals Agatha Christie!
Description_The_Complete_Father_Brown: Father Brown is an English crime-solving priest with a sympathetic ear and sharp insight into human nature. This collection comprises 49 cases featuring the beloved cassock-wearing, bicycle-riding detective in the fictional village of Kembleford.
Description_If_Beale_Street_Could_Talk: Tish and Fonny are engaged and expecting a child, when Fonny is jailed for a crime he didn't commit. Their families band together to try to clear his name. An emotionally devastating love story about racial prejudice and criminal injustice.
Description_Mend!;A_Refashioning_Manual_: Decrease the number of clothes you toss, and learn how to repair them in ways that make them a work of art! A how-to guide explaining the process and possibilities of mending, perfect for the experienced sewist or the person who’s never picked up a needle.
Description_Our_Town: This Pulitzer Prize-winning play is about the tragic beauty of life's journey, as seen through the residents of Grover's Corners, a fictional town in 1930s New Hampshire.
Description_The_Long_Way_to_a_Small,_Ang: In this queer space opera, a rag-tag team of travellers take a dangerous job tunnelling a wormhole to a distant planet. The commission of a lifetime might not pay off, but the found-family in this sci-fi series sure does!
Description_Room: Five-year-old Jack's entire world is confined to a single room with his mother. She created a plan to escape their mysterious prison, but Jack will need to follow it exactly for it to work. An emotional thriller told through the voice of a young child.
Description_The_Three-Body_Problem;Remem: Scientists disappear after entering a virtual reality 'game'. The military set an outgoing message of peace to other planets, but a woman familiar with violence corrected the broadcast. The first book in a dramatic Hugo Award-winning series from author Cixin Liu.
Description_Death_of_a_Salesman;Certain_: It's 1940 and Willy Loman is as fatally insecure as his career. This depressing play asks whether the pursuit of the consumerist American dream is really all it's cracked up to be.
Description_A_Man_for_All_Seasons: This biographical dramatisation follows the escalating conflict between Lord Chancellor Sir Thomas More and Henry VIII from 1529 to 1535. As Henry pushes political and religious buttons, More pushes back. A historical play that will leave you wanting more.
Description_Hard_Times: Meet Bouderby and Gradgrind, two men of industry. Their flawed views on life are evident in the outlooks of three children: Louisa, Thomas, and Cecilia. A comedic romance set amid the smoggy circus of mid-19th-century industrial society.
Description_Lessons_in_Chemistry: Elizabeth Zott is a brilliant chemist. But it's the 1950s, so men are constantly shutting doors in her face. A TV producer needs a host for a new cooking show. Cooking is chemistry, after all. A feminist historical fiction with a sad love story, equal parts infuriating and inspiring!
Description_Salt,_Fat,_Acid,_Heat;Master: To learn cooking, you must first master the four elements... Samin Nosrat has taught chefs of all ages and stages how to perfect the flavour, balance, and texture of food using salt, fat, acid, and heat. Includes 150 illustrations + infographics to guide your culinary journey!
Description_Walden: Ever wanted to walk away from civilisation, into the woods, and owe nothing to anyone but yourself? You'll find a friend in Henry David Thoreau. His record of simple living and contemplation of civil disobedience will fascinate nature-lovers and deep thinkers alike.
Description_The_Comfort_Book_: Matt saved all the little pieces of encouragement that kept him going, and put them in this book. This self-help book is an invitation to reflect and rebuild your hope. Take what you need!
Description_Crying_in_H_Mart: A heartfelt memoir from the artist behind Japanese Breakfast. Michelle writes about how grief sent her back to her Korean heritage for grounding and comfort, including the dishes she used to share with her mother.
Description_True_Grit: It's 1878, and fourteen-year-old Mattie wants vengeance. Tom Chaney took her father's life, his horse, and $150 in cash. Mattie convinces Rooster Cogburn, the toughest U.S. Marshal in the west, to accompany her in a manhunt across Indian territory.
Description_The_How_of_Happiness;A_Scien: An easy guide for finding and feeling happy! Learn the scientific research behind sustaining happiness, and make it personal with quizzes and exercises to explore where and how you experience joy.
Description_Pink_Eraser_Art;The_Ultimate: Learn how to make tiny block prints using an overlooked school supply–pink erasers! Artist Serena Rios McRae tells readers everything they need to get started, including where to find inspiration, in this step-by-step guide.
Description_Evelina: Evelina is a naive young woman who learns firsthand about the dangers of fashionable society. A sharply comedic painting of excess, love, and women's status in eighteenth-century London. A novel from one of Jane Austen's favourite authors!
Description_Dickens_at_Christmas: Bah! Humbug! A collection of Dickens' famous Christmas tales, both heartwarming and spooky. This edition includes A Christmas Carol, The Chimes, A Cricket on the Hearth, Battle of Life, and the Haunted Man.
Description_House_of_Many_Ways;(The_Movi: Charmain agreed to house sit. She didn't know it meant looking after a house that moves through space and time, an apprentice wizard, a stray dog, and a quest for something called the Elfgift. The marvellous middle grade sequel to Howl's Moving Castle!
Description_Finance_for_the_People;Getti: An friendly how-to guide for mindfully approaching your finances. Paco de Leon helps readers identify their biases: beliefs, societal expectations, and family examples, in order to escape debt, notice how gratitude impacts their spending, and start building wealth.
Description_Foster: A small girl from a loud house goes to stay at a farm in rural Ireland. There, she receives the kind of attention that was rare in her large family, and her hosts share a love previously blocked by grief. A tiny novella full of concern and comfort.
Description_The_Other_Bennet_Sister: Pride and Prejudice, but make it about Mary Bennet! When Longbourn is taken at last by Mr. Collins, the bookish and reserved Mary finds herself on a journey from one sister’s home to another, making a personal study of what makes a good marriage.
Description_Know_My_Name_: In the news, she was known only as Emily Doe. Chanel’s experience, an example of the justice system failing the most vulnerable, went viral after her victim impact statement was posted on Buzzfeed. A powerful memoir told in uniquely beautiful prose.
Description_How_Not_to_Kill_Your_Housepl: Do you have a plant graveyard? Learn how to help your plants thrive, or at the bare minimum, survive in this practical how-to guide. Includes tips for how to triage common plant problems so you can rescue them before it's too late!
Description_Steal_Like_an_Artist;10_Thin: A little book of ideas for how to translate your inspiration into creative output. A practical guide for artists and people who just don't know they're creative yet!
Description_Pride_and_Prejudice: A regency romance novel about poor first impressions, messy family dynamics, and unequal affections that became one of the world's most beloved books. Includes miscommunication, sisterhood, and excellent boiled potatoes.
Description_The_Acts_of_King_Arthur_and_: This adaptation of Malory's Morte d'Arthur (The Death of King Arthur) was published after the author's death. Steinbeck tried using modern language within the frame of Middle English. Proving yet again that authors with weird fixations write the most interesting books.
Description_Borne: In a post-apocalyptic city, climate refugee Rachel adopts a surreal creature. The creature's questions hold a mirror to humanity, reflecting back the good, the bad, and the absurd. But is Borne as innocent as they seem, or merely a quiet, growing threat?
Description_Dragonology;The_Complete_Boo: Dr Drake’s quintessential guide for any budding dragonologist. Learn how to identify different dragon species, understand their biology, and live peaceably alongside them. Contains maps, specimens, and secret messages to spark the imagination!
Description_The_Eleventh_Hour;A_Curious_: Horace the elephant invites his friends to celebrate his eleventh birthday with a feast, only to discover that it has been eaten at the eleventh hour! Can you find the hidden messages and solve the mystery of who ate the birthday feast?
Description_Nature;Encyclopedia_of_Disco: Discover the wonders of the natural world, from plants and animals to volcanoes and outer space. The immersive illustrations and diagrams make learning a delight for all ages.
Description_Tell_Me_Why: How big is the universe? What is fire? Why do we eat food? Uncover the answers to these questions and more with charming illustrations and explanations perfect for young minds.
Description_Lotus_Blue: Seventeen-year-old Star is a nomad in the post-apocalyptic Australian desert. The crash of a satellite begins a chain of events that pulls Star far from her home and into the world of ancient war machines in this YA sci-fi epic.
Description_A_Gothic_Cookbook;Hauntingly: Feast your way through thirteen Gothic stories, from The Bloody Chamber to The Woman in White. The illustrated cookbook that invites readers to devour the literary classics.
Description_Scheherazade's_Cat;&_Other_F: An anthology of folklore from around the globe, including a retelling of the One Thousand and One Nights legend.
Description_Unwitting_Wisdom;An_Antholog: A collection of twelve of Aesop's fables, brought to life with beautiful illustrations. Discover the allegories that have enchanted children over 2500 years.
Description_Rosalind_Franklin;_The_Dark_: Rosalind Franklin's contribution to one of the greatest discoveries of the 20th century wasn't acknowledged during her lifetime. This is an excellent biography of the woman whose research was crucial in determining the structure of DNA.
Description_Cats_in_Space..._and_Other_P: Love cats? Love space? You’ll love this. Revel in feline supremacy while reading tales by the likes of Ursula Le Guin, Arthur C. Clarke and Anne McCaffrey. Approved by Freya!
Description_Just_Six_Numbers;_The_Deep_F: Ready to have your mind blown? Discover how the slightest change to six very important numbers would have led to a very different Universe and to us never having existed.
Description_The_Eyre_Affair: Must-read for fans of literature, absurdity and sci-fi. First in the Thursday Next series — it’s a story that includes a criminal mastermind, dodos and a date to see the strangest performance of Richard III you will ever encounter.
Description_The_Kamogawa_Food_Detectives: Delicious in its simplicity and glorious descriptions of Japanese cuisine; the story revolves around a father and daughter who own a unique restaurant. Customers come looking to have dishes that hold special places in their hearts recreated.
Description_The_Dark_Is_Rising: Following a terrifying night, Will wakes on his 11th birthday to a world covered in snow and a world changed. Will learns that he is one of the Old Ones and joins the battle against the Dark. Second in a classic fantasy series for kids.
Description_Bookworm;_A_Memoir_of_Childh: Part memoir, part love letter to children’s literature, you will revisit childhood favourites and likely find gems you missed the first time round. Ideally, read wrapped in a blanket and in a window seat if at all possible.
Description_Z_For_Zachariah: When her brother left the valley and didn’t return, Ann assumed that she was the last survivor of a nuclear war. That is, until a stranger in a radiation suit appeared. Why was he here? What did he want? A thrilling tale of survival and not knowing who to trust.
Description_Battle_Royale: Teens trapped on an island in a fight to the death? No, not that one! Junior high school students are forced to kill each other by a fictional, fascist Japanese government. The original novel has a powerful political message.
Description_The_Radium_Girls: A fascinating, harrowing account of the American girls hired to paint clock faces using radium in the early 1900s. Relive their battle for justice against an industry that valued profit over the lives of their female workforce. Contains graphic descriptions of medical conditions.
Description_The_Animals_of_Farthing_Wood: The book behind a TV series that traumatised an entire generation recounts the journey of Fox, Badger, Mole and the other inhabitants of Farthing Wood as they strike out trying to find a new home. Their heart-breaking story continues in a further six books.
Description_Charmed_Life;_(Chrestomanci,: In the first of the Chrestomanci Series we meet Eric ‘Cat’ Chant. After the death of his parents, he and his sister move into Chrestomanci Castle to live with the world’s most powerful enchanter and his family. Things, however, aren’t quite what they appear to be.
Description_The_Dark_Portal;_Book_One_of: No one has ever seen Jupiter, the living god worshipped by the rats living below Deptford. In this dark fantasy, Audrey, a young mouse, ventures into the sewers where she discovers her missing father was last seen in Jupiter's altar chamber. A thrilling read for kids.
Description_Boy's_Life: When a boy and his father witness the aftermath of a gruesome murder, their lives become haunted by paranoia. The boy is forced to grow up quickly in a town where every friendly face becomes a potential murderer.
Description_Something_Wicked_This_Way_Co: A mysterious carnival rolls into town three hours after midnight and a week early for Halloween. Drawn by its eerie allure, two boys sneak out to see the dark circus arrive. This surreal tale is about adolescence and the fear of getting older.
Description_The_Complete_Peanuts;_1993-1: This collector's edition series compiles all 50 years of Peanuts comic strips published in newspapers from 1950 to 2000. Each volume contains two years of Charlie Brown and Snoopy's adventures to make you laugh and break your heart.
Description_Soul_Music;_Discworld_#16,_D: This novel could be about sex and drugs and rock 'n roll, but it is about a rock band. Also, there is a troll in the band, and a dwarf, and a suspiciously elvish-looking guy. The medieval ears of Discworld's citizens will hear metal, DEATH metal, so to speak!
Description_The_Truth;_Discworld_#25,_In: Hear ye, hear ye! Ankh-Morpork has just invented the newspaper, the so-called source of the Truth. They thought revealing the Truth about political corruption and magical intrigues would blow citizens’ minds, but a funny-shaped fruit is all the readers talk about!
Description_Night_Watch;_Discworld_#29,_: Becoming a parent makes you fear that your child will blame you for letting the world rot. As the captain of the City Watch, Sam Vimes has some cleaning to do before the birth, in Ankh-Morpork... The most corrupt, dangerous, and filthy city of all time.
Description_A_Slip_of_the_Keyboard;_Coll: Did Terry Pratchett enjoy book signings? What was the weirdest fan mail he received? Why did he need an assistant to type? This collection of memories and essays by the Discworld author opens up his beliefs, illness, wishes, and love for mushrooms.
Description_The_Colour_of_Magic;_Discwor: "Wow! Is this that famous inn where all barbarians and adventurers get drunk and fight?" As a wizard, Rincewind studied forms of intelligence that can be found in many alternate realities. Yet this "tourist" in Ankh-Morpork is a curious case in terms of intelligence.
Description_Life_is_Better_When_You_Draw: To draw what you see, you need to take in all the details of that moment, which makes you more aware of the moment you are living in and thus enjoy it more. This book is not here to teach you how to draw, but to inspire you to draw, nonprofessionally!
Description_Firefly:_Big_Damn_Hero;_Fire: This book series continues the story of the Serenity’s crew we never got to see in the TV series. Bounty hunters, hired criminals, mysterious research labs, brown coats, homey spaceships, allies, enemies, laughter, and drama... This space western has it all!
Description_Do_Androids_Dream_of_Electri: Androids were created to serve humans, but sometimes they go rogue. Rick Deckard is a detective whose job is to hunt those androids and fix their faulty systems. However, this last job makes him think about what exactly it is that makes a human non-android.
Description_Flow_My_Tears,_the_Policeman: Everyone knew Jason Taverner, the famous TV star. But when all his identification goes missing, people cannot remember or acknowledge his existence. This science fiction novel explores what it means to have an identity in a reality shaped by a totalitarian police state.
Description_Understanding_Comics;The_Inv: This book makes you appreciate both creating and reading comics as a hobby even more! By going over the history of visual storytelling, it explains how design choices — often invisible to readers’ eyes — affect the reading experience.
Description_The_CRPG_Book;Guide_to_Compu: This encyclopedia tells the history of computer role-playing games by listing all CRPG titles released up to 2020 in chronological order. You can see how games influenced each other and role-playing practices, both in digital and tabletop settings.
Description_The_New_Encyclopedia_of_Brit: This illustrated guide is a perfect companion for birdwatching, a scientific encyclopedia to start learning about birds and a source of inspiration for a birdwatching trip in Europe or Africa!
Description_The_World_of_Encyclopedia_of: Across continents and different biomes, this scientific encyclopedia illustrates trees from all around the world. Do you want to recognize a tree by its leaves and learn its unique characteristics? Here is your guide!
Description_Nation: Mau is the only member of his nation since a huge wave destroyed his village and wiped out his tribe. Now all alone, this boy defies death and demands answers: Why did the gods let this happen to the elders? Who will judge whether he becomes a man or remains a boy?
Description_Blood,_Sweat,_and_Pixels: Jason Schreier documents how ten famous video games were developed by interviewing their developers retrospectively. These real stories of dedication, hope, suffering, and frustration reveal the intricacies of the game industry.
Description_Weird_Tales;100_Years_of_Wei: This 100th-year compendium of Weird Tales magazine collects stories, poems, and essays blending fantasy, horror, occult, and the uncanny. Featuring cosmic horror, dark magic, eerie creatures, nightmarish insanity, shaken detectives, and worlds that defy reason.
Description_The_Dice_Man;_Dice_Man_#1: A psychiatrist, to entertain himself, rolls a die and lets the result determine what he will do next. This activity quickly transforms into a ritual of a newborn religion, where people live by what is determined by the die, forgoing their own will.
Description_Asterios_Polyp: Asterios is one of the world’s greatest architects. This award-winning graphic novel follows how the rigid lines of his personality and architectural style shatter, sending him on an aimless journey that transforms a once self-absorbed man into someone who cares.
Description_The_Harmony_Silk_Factory: Johnny is the hero of Kinta Valley, celebrated for his fierce resistance against Japanese soldiers during WWII. But behind this façade lies a criminal who betrays the trust of those who revere him. A fictional, historical novel about love, deception and humanity.
Description_The_Weight_of_Our_Sky: In this historical YA novel, follow Melati, a Malaysian girl with OCD, as she embarks on a journey to reunite with her mother during the brutal 1969 racial riots that engulfed the city of Kuala Lumpur.
Description_Femme_in_Public: Queer artist Alok shares their journey navigating family and American society as a gender non-conforming, Indian diasporic, trans femme in this heartfelt collection of poems.
Description_Ace;_What_Asexuality_Reveals: What does it mean to be asexual? Reimagine human connection by exploring intersections of identity, sexuality and culture through a collection of critiques, reflections and conversations with community.
Description_Iron_Widow;_Book_1: Rage against the patriarchy in the first installment of this Chinese history-inspired, feminist sci-fi YA novel! Follow 18-year-old Wu Zetian as she pilots giant mechas, avenges her sister's death and overthrows the sexist, militaristic society of Huaxia.
Description_So_Easy_So_Good: Packed with recipes and information on healthy eating, this cookbook draws from Kylie's expertise as a Japanese-American dietician to make cooking accessible, practical and delicious for all.
Description_One_Piece;_Volume_1: Sail the seas in this action-packed manga with Monkey D. Luffy and his crew, the Straw Hat Pirates! Follow Luffy as he goes on a journey to search for the treasure One Piece, and become King of the Pirates.
Description_Pedagogy_of_the_Oppressed: This foundational text illustrates how traditional teaching modes reinforce colonial and classist power imbalances, and proposes an alternative that treats students as co-creators of knowledge via dialogue and collaboration.
