Description_The_Left_Hand_of_Darkness: Part of Le Guin's Hainish Cycle, this timeless sci-fi novel follows the tale of Genly Ai and Estraven on a rich, emotional journey about cultural barriers, gender, humanity, friendship and love.
Description_Birdland: Watch the unravelling of Paul, a rock star at the prime of his career, in this cautionary play about fame and celebrity culture.
Description_Non-Binary_Lives;_An_Antholo: Exploring what it means to be non-binary in the 21st century, this collection of essays shares how the gender identities of non-binary people across diverse backgrounds intersect and impact other aspects of their lives.
Description_Mastering_the_Art_of_French_: If you think the rich and complex-seeming French cuisine is only attainable in France, Julia Child is here to prove you wrong. With alternative, affordable ingredients, cheeky shortcuts and clear instructions, any cook can become a French chef. Bon appétit!
Description_The_Boy,_The_Mole,_The_Fox_a: In a world where we have to navigate so much, unlikely friends often help us find our way home. So goes for the boy, the mole, the fox, and the horse, who share their life lessons along the way. With beautiful watercolour pictures, this is truly a book for all ages!
Description_The_Life-Changing_Magic_of_T: Do you feel like your house is more treasure trove than home? Want to get a grip on the never-ending tidying? Marie Kondo is here to help with plenty of systems to organise your belongings. And remember: if it doesn’t spark joy, throw it away!
Description_The_Hitchhiker’s_Guide_To_Th: When the Earth gets destroyed, Arthur Dent teams up with other humans, aliens and robots to find out why the answer to the Ultimate Question of Life, the Universe, and Everything is 42. Join him in this hilarious sci-fi journey that will take you way past your own imagination!
Description_Extremely_Loud_&_Incredibly_: Nine-year-old Oskar finds a mysterious key in his deceased father’s closet. Determined to find out which lock the key belongs to, Oskar’s journey takes him beyond his boundaries as he meets different people who are also searching for something in life.
Description_The_Metamorphosis: Have you ever felt like life has no meaning but to work hard and live by routine? So does Gregor, who wakes up one day and finds he’s turned into a bug. Follow along as Gregor re-invents himself in this surreal and dystopian story, defining the meaning of Kafkaesque.
Description_The_Complete_Illustrated_Enc: Discover your environment one chirp, tweet or whistle at a time with this extremely detailed and very specific encyclopaedia. Do you really need more information than the title?
Description_To_Your_Eternity: In this beautifully illustrated and tear-jerking* manga, you’re taken on an incredible journey with Fushi. With every new encounter, this immortal being learns about kindness, love, friendship, but also hardships in life. *Tissues not included.
Description_The_Play_That_Goes_Wrong: Welcome to this murder mystery where everything goes exactly as planned (not)! This farce provides hilarious slapstick humour with various mistakes, accidents, prop malfunctions and more. Will you ever find the murderer? Who knows!
Description_Medea: After Medea's husband Jason leaves her and their two children for another woman, no one is prepared for how Medea gets her revenge. An ancient Greek tragedy reminding us all that there is nothing more dangerous than a woman scorned.
Description_Antigone: The tale of a sister who will fight to honour her brothers after their death, no matter the cost. A tragic play about the strength of familial love and the consequences of defiance.
Description_Fruits_Basket;_Volume_1: Tohru knew the Sohma family was strange, but she still wasn’t ready to watch a boy turn into a cat! Follow her in this magical manga series as she tries to break a twisted curse and save the boy she can’t seem to stay away from.
Description_Gearbreakers;_(Book_1): Gods of metal rule a dystopian world, destroying anyone who stands in their path. The humans who control them aren’t human at all, or so Eris believes until she meets Sona. But Sona is only a glitch, and her gods must still be stopped.
Description_Clap_When_You_Land: Yahaira has lost her father, her hero. Camino has lost her father, a near stranger. Both have gained a sister. In this powerful story written in verse, two girls learn to grieve and dream together.
Description_PET: There is a creature in Jam’s home born of paint and blood. The creature is hunting a monster, even though everyone knows there are no more monsters in Lucille. Except, as Jam finds out, no society is made up entirely of angels.
Description_Love_Beyond_Body,_Space_&_Ti: Let yourself get pulled into alternate worlds both on earth and in space in an eclectic collection of pieces by queer, Indigenous authors. This brilliant anthology effortlessly weaves together folklore, faith, and the nature of human connections.
Description_Matched;_(Book_1): Cassia has never had to choose before, but now her choices may be the difference between life and death. Published at the height of dystopias, Matched is a perfect read for teenagers craving romance and rebellion against a corrupt society.
Description_Annabel_Lee: Poe's verse shines beautifully in this haunting and tragic tale of forbidden love. Annabel Lee is a classic poem which immerses the reader in an eerie atmosphere and makes them long for a ghostly girl.
Description_The_Spear_Cuts_Through_Water: You sit in a theatre, eyes riveted on the stage, as a brutal yet hopeful tale of gods, magic, and queer love unfolds in front of you. In this gripping novel, Jimenez turns the reader into an audience and forces them along on a pilgrimage to end a dynasty.
Description_The_Principle_of_Moments;_(T: An unlikely partnership forms as a boy from the past and a girl from the future push the boundaries of time and space to escape tyranny. Dive deep into this lush world of magic, spaceships, and gritty, queer heroes.
Description_Happy_Place: Spending the summer in Maine is a yearly tradition for Harriet, Wyn and their friends. This year, however, there's a catch: Harriet and Wyn broke up months ago, and nobody knows. Can they pretend to be in love for one more week? Or do they even need to pretend at all?
Description_The_Very_Secret_Society_of_I: The story of a witch in need of a job, three magical girls looking for a tutor, and a house desperately seeking to be filled with love and magic. Follow Mika as she turns that house into a home, solves a magical mystery, and maybe falls in love along the way.
Description_Kaikeyi: In this retelling of Hindu mythology, Kaikeyi struggles to be heard in a world of men and gods. When she discovers magic of her own, she turns herself into a warrior queen and mother whose voice cannot be ignored, no matter the cost.
Description_Raybearer;_(Book_1): In Oluwan, only eleven children can be chosen for the Crown Prince's Council and share with him a magical bond like no other. Tarisai, alone and friendless, longs for a connection to him. But can she fight the compulsion to murder him placed on her against her will?
Description_Can't_Spell_Treason_Without_: Come along with Reyna and Kianthe as they escape the clutches of cruel queens and mage obligations in order to open their dream bookshop and tea salon. Watch as the two women fall even more in love and slowly find their place in the world. And what's this about dragons?
Description_Emily_Wilde's_Encyclopaedia_: Told through excerpts from Emily's research journal, this story follows her investigation of the Fair Folk of Hrafnsvik and the disappearances that plague the small town. A tale of magic, folklore, and a fellow professor that Emily cannot stand — or can't she?
Description_Homegoing: In 18th century Ghana, one half-sister is married off to a white governor while the other is sold into slavery and sent to the US. This poignant book follows eight generations of the sisters' descendants and highlights the impact of slavery on people and nations alike.
Description_Transmogrify!;_14_Fantastica: A collection of whimsical, magical, extraordinary stories that celebrate trans youth in all of their glory. Full of humour, queerness, and adventures, this collection reminds readers that every community deserves magic and joy.
Description_Wash_Day_Diaries: This beautiful graphic novel brings the reader into the lives of four black women in New York City. Get sucked into their joys, their angers, their issues, and their loves, in a story that celebrates and empowers black women in the modern US.
Description_Last_Night_at_the_Telegraph_: It's 1954 in Chinatown, and Lily Hu feels too young to be dealing with her budding queerness on top of the Red Scare and fear of deportation. Lo delves into the history of lesbian bars, discrimination, and Chinese immigration, while weaving a powerful queer love story.
Description_Topdog/Underdog: Booth wants to be as good at three-card monte as his older brother Lincoln, who’s sworn off the hustling life. Money’s tight, and Lincoln’s honest work isn’t going to get them far, as this one-room play explores the intersection of race, poverty, and brotherhood.
Description_Blithe_Spirit: When a seance goes hilariously wrong, novelist Charles finds himself haunted by the ghost of his first wife, Elvira. Jealous of his new wife, Elvira acts out in desperation to keep Charles with her. A slapstick onstage farce of ghostly proportions!
Description_Stage_Kiss: What happens when an actress gets cast in a play opposite her former lover, both playing former lovers on stage? What happens when the stage kissing starts to feel more and more real? A backstage comedy about romance and what happens after the curtain falls.
Description_Eurydice: This play is a love story. Or is it? It’s hard to tell, with all the forgetting. Try again: this is a maybe love story about Eurydice, who dies on her wedding day and is taken to the Underworld. Orpheus is coming to rescue her, but Eurydice is starting to forget day by day.
Description_Oh,_Mary!: In this play, all Mary Todd Lincoln wants to do is star in a cabaret and drink, but instead she is forced to stay cooped up in Washington, DC, while her husband deals with the Civil War. Desperate to distract her, Abe hires an acting coach to give her lessons on the stage.
Description_Fleabag: The play that inspired the TV series, Fleabag is a one-woman show following the disastrous yet hilarious life of the titular character as she tries to navigate her mess of a love life while dealing with her eccentric family and mourning the death of her best friend.
Description_Sorcery_and_Small_Magics;The: Leovander Loveage has a problem. His charms got mixed up, and now he’s been cursed to obey any command by his academic rival, the sullen Sebastian Grimm. Now they have to find a counterspell, and fast, in the first book of this queer fantasy series!
Description_Vicious;_Villains_#1: College students Victor and Eli have discovered the impossible: the creation of superhuman abilities. But when one of their experiments turns deadly, Victor is charged with murder. Ten years later, Victor escapes with one thought in mind: find and kill Eli Cardale. The first in a thrilling sci-fi series with unforeseen twists and turns.
Description_The_Crucible: Did you dance with the devil last night? A critique of McCarthyism in the 1950s, this play uses the 1692 Salem witch trials to show how theocracy and personal vindictiveness are dangerous breeding grounds for hysteria-induced persecution.
Description_The_Pillowman: In this horrific stage play, police bring in short story author Katurian for questioning about a series of brutal murders involving children. Upon hearing the evidence, Katurian faces the horrifying reality that the murderer has been mimicking the events of his own disturbing fables.
Description_Alanna;_The_First_Adventure_: Alanna disguises herself as a boy to become a knight — but keeping that secret in between combat training, dealing with her magical Gift, making friends (and enemies!), and growing up is a tall order in this foundational youth fantasy work.
Description_Among_the_Hidden;_(The_Shado: As the third child in his family, Luke’s very existence is forbidden. When he meets another forbidden child, can the pair execute a dangerous plan to escape the shadows? The first in the dystopian Shadow Children series.
Description_The_Princess_Saves_Herself_i: The first of the Women are Some Kind of Magic series, this poetry collection examines facets of the poet’s life through fairy tale imagery and tropes while offering a message of empowerment to readers.
Description_Small_Spaces;_(Book_1): With little more than ominous advice and stories of “the smiling man,” Ollie and her classmates find themselves in a chilling race for survival when their bus breaks down on the way home from a field trip in this spooky series starter.
Description_Chain-Gang_All-Stars: For nearly three years, Loretta has fought and killed, hoping to win her own freedom. Told in multiple perspectives, this brutal dystopian novel highlights the horrors of the US prison system and society's obsession with reality entertainment.
Description_Siren_Queen: Magic weaves itself into every fibre of Golden-Age, where survival isn't guaranteed, as magic binds those seeking fame to a future of blood, sweat, and sacrifices. In order to make it, Luli Wei may have to give up everything — including the women she loves — in this stunning historical fantasy.
Description_The_Enigma_Girls;_How_Ten_Te: The true stories of ten teenage girls who were among the young women with unique skills recruited to decode and translate messages at Bletchley Park during World War II. While written for young readers, adults will also be fascinated by these tales.
Description_A_Good_Day_to_Pie;_(Pies_Bef: In this cosy baking mystery, Daisy doesn't expect the target for one of her deadly pies to be a judge of the baking show she's entered. When he dies before she can even deliver his pie, she has to find out who did it — and if they know about her secret side-business.
Description_Upright_Women_Wanted: Librarians fighting fascism in a near-future Wild West? It's more likely than you think! Esther runs away to escape an arranged marriage and discovers the importance of resistance as she learns to embrace her own queer identity.
Description_Bait_and_Witch;_(Witch_Way_L: Josie expected to lie low in Wilfred, Oregon for a bit when she took a job as the small town's only librarian. She didn't expect latent magic powers, a fight to save the library from being torn down, or finding a body in the woods, but has to tackle all three head-on.
Description_Star-Crossed: Eighth grade Mattie has good grades, loves reading, and has a crush on a boy in her class. But when the school production of Romeo & Juliet gets underway she finds herself with a whole new crush – on the girl playing Juliet!
Description_The_Tapper_Twins_Run_for_Pre: Overachiever Claudia and slacker Reese may be twins, but they couldn’t be more different. When they find themselves running against one another for class president (for wildly different reasons), sibling shenanigans might just ruin both their chances!
Description_Nevermoor;_The_Trials_of_Mor: Cursed to die on her 11th birthday Morrigan is instead whisked away to a world she never knew existed to compete for membership in a secret society. Sure, it’s a preferable fate – but that doesn’t mean it’ll be easy!
Description_Dealing_With_Dragons;_(Encha: To get out of being a typical princess, Cimorene volunteers to be a dragon's princess so she can pursue her own interests. Over-enthusiastic knights, a suitor who just won't go, nosy wizards, and dragon politics were NOT part of the plan!
Description_The_Bar_Code_Tattoo;_(Bar_Co: Everyone’s getting the bar code tattoo. When Kayla decides not to, her life as she knows it is thrown upside down and she finds herself on the run and wondering what exactly is the bar code tattoo – and why does everyone need one – in this YA sci-fi dystopia.
Description_This_Was_Our_Pact: No one turns for home. No one looks back. That’s the promise Ben and his friends made as they set out to follow the paper lanterns go. Eventually it’s only Ben and Nathaniel on a delightfully weird and magical journey in this stunning graphic novel.
Description_Lysistrata: A delightfully devious play demonstrating the power of women and shared protest through unconventional means. Will the booty be too strong to resist for Lysistrata and her friends? Or will they bring an end to the Peloponnesian War?
Description_The_Fifth_Season: Three powerful and persecuted women travel across a broken and dangerous landscape. They search for answers about their ancestry, the cause of the great rupture that divided the land... and how their innate ability to control the earth maaaybe played a part.
Description_Madame_Bovary's_Ovaries;_a_D: Ever wanted to look at the study of evolution through literary eyes? Look no further! This book will take you on a tour of literary classics seen through an evolutionary biologist's lens, sharing interesting facts about animal and human biology, sociology, and culture.
Description_Hatchet: A 13-year-old boy named Brian gets stranded in the Canadian wilderness and has to survive with nothing but the damaged supplies from the plane wreck. Alone, but with the luck of the young, Brian takes on the great outdoors and learns he's not half bad at hunting.
Description_The_Notebooks_of_Malte_Lauri: A deeply insightful near auto-biography, this book is bound to satisfy your urge for poetic prose but increase your urge for self-reflection — in the aristocratic, slightly depressing and very serious way. If you want to see death on every corner, this one's for you.
Description_Wired_for_Story: Hey, you! Writer! This is the one you're looking for. Lisa Cron delivers tips on writing well in a way that uses how our brains are — wait for it — wired for story. Learn cool things about how brains work, the function and impact of story, and boost your writing!
Description_Baroque: Aptly titled, Baroque covers the Baroque period of art and antiquity in Europe. There are 226 illustrations to go along with the drier descriptions, but if you read carefully, you'll become an amateur expert on the Baroque! How's that for a party trick?
Description_Wide_Sargasso_Sea: Ever read Charlotte Brontë's Jane Eyre and think: I wonder how that woman ended up in the attic and being labelled crazy? Wonder no more. Jean Rhys takes that perspective, giving Antoinette a rich, dramatic, and slightly terrifying backstory that reeks of betrayal.
Description_Arnheim's_Principles_of_Athl: This book is so competency-based, you'll be diagnosing old injuries in everyone you see and testing range of motion on yourself constantly. Learn how to treat sprained ankles, wrap a bandage, and other helpful training tips for the average athlete. Possibly outdated!
Description_Leviathan_Wakes;The_Expanse_: Join Holden as he starts down a path that almost certainly leads to painful, weird death for him and all humans, but also potentially endless opportunity. With his quirky yet tight-knit mercenary crew by his side, space has never seemed more inviting nor more dangerous.
Description_tree_houses;baumhäuser_–_mai: This trilingual book shows that building tree houses is not just fun for children. Beautiful pictures and descriptions of 30 tree houses from around the world: From private dream homes to luxury restaurants to a cathedral.
Description_Eye_of_the_Storm;_(Reel_Magi: After a wild storm haunts Bookstonbury's shores, four adventurous kids find a mischievous mermaid by an old shipwreck. Sneaking kelp tea and dodging nosy adults, they decode slippery clues to help her uncover something fishy hidden beneath the waves.
Description_An_Experiment_with_an_Air_Pu: On the cusp of a new century, deep in the throes of scientific discovery, one house has concealed a secret for 200 years; a literal body in the basement! This play jumps between the past and present, examining scientific ethics and dramatics.
Description_All_My_Sons: Set in the Midwest after WWII, this play is a fragmented family drama and tragedy. A father and son, a forbidden romance, unpunished crimes, and a dark secret that threatens to tear the characters apart.
Description_All_Out;The_No-Longer-Secret: An anthology of queer historical fiction, telling captivating and emotive stories which take you on a journey through history. Experience a diverse range of identities, stories, and cultures in this vibrant expression of queer history.
Description_How_to_Get_a_Girlfriend_(Whe: Love queer paranormal romance? How about some funky space excursions and blushing eldritch abominations? Well, this novella is for you! A blend of science, space, magic, and lesbians… surely nothing will go wrong!
Description_Taproot: Falling in love with your best friend isn’t ideal… especially when you’re dead. Luckily, Hamal can see ghosts, so Blue keeps him company. But something strange is happening in this queer graphic novel, and the pair are running out of time.
Description_Meat_Lovers: Tender and grotesque, gentle and harrowing, this queer, mature poetry collection is split into two parts, ‘Meat’ and ‘Lovers’. Their boundaries blur, love and flesh merging together in a dance so enthralling that you can’t look away.
Description_Out_Here: An anthology of Takatāpui and LGBTQIA+ writers from Aotearoa New Zealand. A dazzling collection of poetry, short stories, personal essays, and comics; a beautiful exploration of queer identity and humanity.
Description_Fun_Home;_A_Family_Tragicomi: Creator of the famous ‘Bechdel’ test, this is Alison Bechdel’s graphic novel memoir, exploring her relationship with her queerness and her late father, and how the overlap between them turned out to be much greater than she realised.
Description_Leaves_of_Grass: Deemed obscene by some critics for its sensual nature, this poetry collection is an expression of gay voices in the 1800s. Whitman speaks of how queer love is still God’s love, and also that such love should be normalised and celebrated.
Description_The_Redemption_of_Althalus: A goddess who takes the form of a talking cat, a reluctantly reformed thief and troublemaker, and endless time shenanigans; this delightfully humorous epic fantasy has everything you’re looking for!
Description_Don't_Let_the_Forest_In: A gothic high school, a haunted writer, a secretive artist. Andrew and Thomas must fight back the monstrosities born from the art they created, while their feelings for each other grow tangled and wild.
Description_The_Forests_of_Silence;(Delt: In this epic quest for young readers, a pair of unexpected heroes must face untold dangers as they search for the lost magical gems that could save them from the tyrannical Shadow Lord. Their first destination? The Forests of Silence.
Description_Spring_Clean: A soft and touching poetry collection, exploring memories both painful and nostalgic. Teaches readers the importance of a spring clean, making space to reflect on the past to see a brighter future.
Description_The_Ruins_of_Gorlan_;_(Range: Rangers are mysterious figures, believed to practice strange magic. But when young Will is chosen to become a Ranger’s apprentice, he discovers a whole new world of secrets. And on the horizon, a fierce enemy wakes…
Description_The_Outcasts_;_(Brotherband_: In the world of Ranger’s Apprentice, across the sea, a plucky group of boys come together to form their own brotherband. A story of humorous pirating vikings, boys growing up, and fierce friendships.
Description_The_Final_Empire;_Mistborn_#: For a thousand years, ash has fallen from the sky. The noble elite live in luxury while the skaa slaves toil in terror—until a cynical young thief discovers she harbors a rare and extraordinary power.
Description_The_Templars;The_Rise_and_Sp: A faltering war in the Middle East. A band of elite knights ready to die for Christianity’s holiest sites. A secret financial empire answerable to no king and a deadly conspiracy built on lies…
Description_The_Wars_of_The_Roses;The_Fa: The Hollow Crown: 15th-century England—Five kings, endless war. Plantagenets rip themselves apart in the Wars of the Roses. Agincourt glory, Towton bloodbath, Richard III’s murdered nephews...
One book. Two readers. A deadly mystery in the margins. A revolutionary novel and a dangerous love story collide. Part puzzle, part thriller, totally unforgettable.
Description_Ladurée:_The_Sweet_Recipes: For the first time, Ladurée unveils the secret recipes behind its legendary macarons and iconic pastries: rose-strawberry choux, pistachio financiers, and every flavor of the world-famous macarons...
Description_Spellbreaker;Spellbreaker_Du: In a world where magic has a price, orphaned Elsie Camden was born to shatter spells, for free. Elsie must master her forbidden gift, uncover her hidden past, and trust the one man who could destroy her, before dark forces silence spellbreakers forever.
Description_The_Binding: After a breakdown, young Emmett Farmer is apprenticed to a mysterious bookbinder. He learns to craft beautiful volumes that cage people’s darkest secrets, yet one locked vault remains off-limits.
Description_New_Hampshire_: A collection of poems and first Pulitzer Prize winning work by Robert Frost. His work is best known for its somber tone and descriptions of nature. Contains highly influential poems such as Fire and Ice and Nothing Gold Can Stay.
Description_Russians_in_Alaska,_1732-186: A comprehensive overview of a time when Alaska was once Russian. The harsh exploitation of people, natural resources, socioeconomic factors, and the complexity of relationships formed from this time are covered in this definitive work.
Description_It_Can't_Happen_Here: Caught in a wave of fascism, the controversial “Buzz” manages to win the United States presidential election by promising greatness. Drastic changes quickly steer the country down a dangerous dystopian path.
Description_A_Tramp_Abroad: An unserious, humorous, mix of real and fictional accounts of travel across Europe. Exaggerated events, his struggle with the German language, and other tales color his journey.
Description_King_Stakh's_Wild_Hunt: Something stalks the foggy marsh as a young folklorist finds himself lost in a family's cursed manor. Will he be able to figure it out or fall to the Wild Hunt? Mysterious and gothic, this Belarusian classic continues to haunt.
Description_The_Encyclopedia_of_the_Weir: Our world and history is a complex and fascinating thing, and this collection of entertaining facts and stories helps humanize our past. From prehistory, ancient games, Pompeii, and more, each page holds an entertaining tale.
Description_Amadeus: Salieri's dreams of becoming history's best composer are threatened when childish upstart Mozart wows Vienna with his musical genius. Can Salieri ruin Mozart's career in time? A play about ambition, treachery, and the lengths one will go for fame.
Description_Homestuck;Book_1:_Act_1_&_2: Read the first two acts of niche webcomic sensation Homestuck, a story about four kids playing a video game that triggers the end of the world. Each page comes with exclusive author commentary! (It's really best read on a web browser though.)
Description_The_Traitor_Baru_Cormorant;(: After her home is colonised by Falcrest, Baru vows to climb the political ranks and destroy the empire from within to free her people. The first in a hard fantasy series filled with political intrigue and lesbian yearning, with a twist ending that will break your heart.
Description_The_History_of_the_Devil: Satan holds a trial to appeal his imprisonment in Hell and argue his right to live in Heaven once more with God. A morbid play which asks philosophical questions about morality and who is worthy of redemption. You won't see the ending coming!
Description_Wolf_in_White_Van: Sean lives in isolation due to a facial disfigurement, spending his days hosting a post-apocalyptic role-playing game played over letters sent to players through the mail. But when two teenagers try to take the game into the real world, tragedy strikes.
Description_Camp_Damascus: Rose has started receiving demonic visions and coughing up swarms of flies. Her investigations into why keep leading her to the gay conversion camp run by her Christian community. But she's never been there before—or has she?
Description_Take_a_Hint_Dani_Brown;(The_: A whipsmart romantic comedy about a PhD student who agrees to fake date her friend—a hopeless-romantic security guard who's been crushing on her for months—to help his mental health charity after a video of him “rescuing” her during a fire drill goes viral.
Description_Face_It;Facial_Disfigurement: James Partridge, burn survivor and disability activist, writes half memoir and half manifesto to educate about the experience of living with, removing the stigma around, and giving frameworks to have a fulfilling life with facial disabilities.
Description_Girls_Like_That: An intimate photo of an unpopular girl gets leaked to her whole school. A sprawling ensemble play told from the mouths of the female classmates who judge her as critically as they judge themselves. A scathing play about gender inequality and cyberbullying.
Description_A_Doll's_House: This classic piece of theatre highlights the injustice of women who are financially dependent and infantilised by their husbands. This play shocked 19th century audiences by depicting a woman choose her independence over her husband and children.
Description_Angels_In_America;A_Gay_Fant: A play so long it’s traditionally shown over two consecutive days, Angels in America explores the 1980's American AIDS crisis in a surrealist deconstruction of religion and sexual identity.
Description_A_Streetcar_Named_Desire: STELLAAA! A classic piece of theatre about starry-eyed southern belle Blanche Dubois, who moves in with her sister and abusive brother-in-law. An interpersonal drama caught between fantasy and brutal reality, with deeply flawed characters colliding in a tragic ending.
Description_Critical_Hits;Writers_on_Gam: An anthology of personal essays by multiple published authors exploring their relationship with video games that affected them deeply. Learn about the transformative world of games and how they shape our lives.
Description_Gideon_the_Ninth;(The_Locked: It's lesbian necromancers in space, baby. Gideon must assist her rival/tormentor Harrowhark, a powerful bone witch, in a series of trials to ensure the survival of the Ninth House. The first book of the Locked Tomb series; bone magic and teenage snark await.
Description_The_Frogs: An ancient Greek comedy about Dionysus' journey into the underworld. Meet Greek heroes, gods, and frogs in his quest to find a playwright who can fix the state of Athenian theatre. A play filled with songs, slapstick, and the iconic frog cry: Brekekekex! Koax! Koax!
Description_Rosencrantz_and_Guildenstern: An absurdist play about follows the titular Rosencrantz and Guildenstern from Hamlet in their quest to help the Danish prince, except they continuously get sidetracked with questions about the human condition.
Description_The_Caucasian_Chalk_Circle: A play-within-a-play culminating in a trial to decide if a boy should go to the rich woman who gave birth to him or the maid who raised him. A piece of Epic Theatre which delivers political themes of justice, class inequality, and the aftermath of war.
Description_Who's_Afraid_of_Virginia_Woo: A play about two couples meeting for a late-night party that quickly deteriorates into snide jokes and volatile fighting as secrets from both couples are laid bare. A dark comedy criticising the American nuclear family and the pressures of socials conformity.
Description_The_Seagull: A dramatic play by Russian playwright Chekhov about the interpersonal relationships of artists, aspiring and jaded alike, in the 19th century Russian countryside. Love triangles, family clashes, and aspirations of fame abound—also Chekhov's gun is definitely in this.
Description_Twelve_Angry_Men: Stuck in a hot room, twelve jurors deliberate over an adolescent's alleged murder of his father. Eleven think he's guilty—except one. Initially written as a teleplay, this piece of theatre explores concepts of prejudice, peer pressure, and justice.
Description_The_7_Stages_of_Grieving: A powerful one-woman play about an Aboriginal woman delivering a series of direct-address monologues and poems connecting the recent death of her Nana with the larger cycles of oppression and grief caused by Australia's colonial history and racist present.
Description_A_Raisin_in_the_Sun: The Youngers, a Black family in 1950s Chicago, await an insurance payment that could radically improve their circumstances but can't agree on how to spend it. A play about the barriers of upward mobility, housing discrimination, and the pressures to assimilate.
Description_Cyrano_de_Bergerac: A 19th century romcom—Cyrano, a skilled wordsmith, fears confessing his love to Roxane due to his large nose. Instead, he gets another man to woo Roxane in his place by giving her the love letters Cyrano writes. A tragicomedic play written entirely in poetic verse.
Description_The_Dry;(Aaron_Falk_#1): Police investigator Aaron Falk returns home for the funeral of his friend in the small Australian town that shunned him years ago. In this outback mystery, Falk uncovers not just how his friend died, but how it’s connected to the crime he was framed for years ago.
Description_The_Catcher_in_the_Rye: Holden Caulfield thinks you're a phony. A disaffected teenager travels around 1950's New York City after he's expelled from school. A literary classic with pages of casually-written monologues lamenting alienation, depression, and the inauthenticity of adults.
Description_The_Life_and_Times_of_the_Wi: Not the musical. A dark retelling of L Frank Baum's famous children's novel, detailing how green-skinned Elphaba Thropp became an enemy of Oz. An (extremely) adult exploration of the politics, interpersonal relationships, and origins of the Wicked Witch of the West.
Description_Stone_Butch_Blues: A butch lesbian comes of age in the world of gay bars, homophobic police raids, and her complex relationship to gender. While unflinching in its depiction of homophobic violence, this book has some of the most achingly romantic prose about love you'll ever read.
Description_Evil_Knits: Do you like things that go bump in the night? What about knitting? This book combines both! Over 20 knitting patterns with detailed instructions on how to make everything from a Nosferatu doll to a zombie egg cozy!
Description_The_Tale_of_Desperaux: A story about rodents, princesses, castles, and soup. Dark, hopeful, and gorgeously-illustrated, follow Desperaux, a little mouse with a big heart who loves stories and proves anyone can be a hero no matter their size.
Description_What_If?_2_;_Additional_Seri: In this book, cartoonist and physicist Randall Munroe tries to answer every question you've never even dreamed of asking, all while staying true to the laws of physics. Unfortunately, most of his hypotheticals end in world destruction. [citation needed]
Description_Yona_of_the_Dawn_;_Volume_17: This manga blends fantasy and comedy in the story of 16-year-old dethroned princess Yona and her Dragon Warriors. In this volume, they deal with the sickness that has taken root in the village that is a battlefield in a war between nations.
Description_Noragami_;_Volume_2: A run-in with stray god Yato has entangled high-school student Hiyori Iki in his endeavours to make a name for himself in a world where small gods are often forgotten. Unfortunately, there is a reason Yato has had a hard time with this: he is not very good at his job. A hilariously magical manga.
Description_Children_of_Time_;_(Book_1): An experiment into accelerated evolution on a terraformed planet was thwarted, but evolution still finds a way. Even on a planet lightyears away, this series presents our society with a mirror when it shows us the problems of a different species. Arachnophobes beware!
Description_Dark_Age_;_(Red_Rising_#5): The war for the solar system continues. When peace has a different meaning to everyone, what does it mean to be a hero? This violent space opera is packed with political intrigue. Whose army will prove itself victorious? And what does victory look like in this truly Dark Age?
Description_Frequently_Asked_Questions_A: The universe is great and vast and full of mysteries. A professor and a cartoonist teamed up to try to explain the answers to the most frequently asked questions.
Description_Elementary_;_The_Periodic_Ta: The universe is made of stardust: some elements that were made in the heaviest of stars can now be found here on Earth. When was each element discovered? And what are they most commonly used for?
Description_Tales_of_Norse_Mythology: A collection of all of the tales from Norse Mythology. This rather dry tome was reprinted with gilded edges. It also contains artwork depicting some of the gods we read about.
Description_Book_of_Yokai_;_Mysterious_C: Yokai is a shorthand for all fantastical beings and supernatural phenomena in Japanese stories. This folkloric encyclopaedia is filled with their origins and meanings.
Description_Lore_Olympus_;_Volume_1: A modern-day retelling of the love story of Hades and Persephone. Wonderfully illustrated, this comic will snatch your heart with whimsical characterisations of the gods you might already be familiar with. And yes: Cerberus is included. Contains mature themes.
Description_ABCC;_A_Bookstonbury_Crochet: Crochet your favourite Bookstonian icons and create your own pocket-sized version of our beautiful town! 120 easy-to-follow and cosy patterns, such as: St Bookston, Raw Fish, Seagull, Mobile Bookshop, Dog, Plants, and many more!
Description_All_Your_Twisted_Secrets: Six high school teenagers meet up under false pretenses and are locked in a room with only one direction: before the hour is up, they must choose one person to die. Amidst the chaos that ensues, a second question rises: who did this to them?
Description_Legendborn_;_The_Legendborn_: A magical story about black women and pain through generations. In this twist on King Arthur’s legend, Bree struggles to find out why she is the only one who can resist the effects of magic and how the secret order she infiltrates relates to her mother’s death.
Description_Red_Rising_;_(Book_1): Darrow grew up fast: at 16 he was a married working man. When, in an act of defiance to a higher order, his wife got herself killed, he rose up to destroy the system from the inside out. Thus starts an epic space war full of plot twists and violence. Hail reaper.
Description_Katabasis: Postgrad school is tough… but navigating Hell to save your professor’s soul? Alice and her academic nemesis Peter team up for the deadliest group project ever. Demons, grudges, and Magick gone wrong await.
Description_Intermezzo: Two grieving brothers navigate love, loss, and the messy bits in between. Peter, the polished lawyer, and Ivan, the awkward chess prodigy, find their lives unravelling in unexpected ways. A tender story of desire, despair, and possibility.
Description_The_Lies_of_Locke_Lamora;_Ge: Locke Lamora: orphan, trickster, occasional disaster. As head of the Gentleman Bastards, he fools nobles, criminals and everyone. But a hidden enemy rises, ready to burn his world down.Time for one last, deadly trick.
Description_Atmosphere: Joan Goodwin has always loved the stars. When she’s selected for NASA’s new astronaut programme, she finds friendship, purpose, and a love she never expected. But one mission will change everything.
Description_Vera_Wong's_Unsolicited_Advi: A dead man in her tea shop? Vera Wong barely blinks. After all, who’s better suited to solve a murder than a sixty year old tea connoisseur with weaponised mum-curiosity? The police don’t stand a chance.
Description_Great_Big_Beautiful_Life: Two writers. One legendary subject. Alice wants her big break. Hayden wants everyone to leave him alone. Instead, they’re trapped on an island competing for the same biography, juggling cryptic stories, ironclad NDAs, and an attraction neither of them requested.
Description_Witchcraft_for_Wayward_Girls: At Wellwood Home, pregnant girls are expected to obey, disappear, and forget. But when Fern finds a book of witchcraft, she and the others discover power they were never meant to hold. And power, in this place, always draws blood.
Description_I_Am_Not_Jessica_Chen: Jenna Chen wishes she were her perfect, Harvard-bound cousin and wakes up as her. At Havenwood Academy, she gains straight As, secrets, and rising dread as everyone forgets Jenna ever existed. How far can perfection go before it erases you?
Description_Sisters_in_Science: Four brilliant women physicists are forced out of Nazi Germany and into a race for survival and discovery. From secret escapes to groundbreaking science, their courage reshapes the field and inspires generations. A true tale of sisterhood under fire.
Description_The_Third_Gilmore_Girl;_A_Me: From A Chorus Line to Gilmore Girls, Kelly Bishop has seen it all. Now she spills the stories: showbiz highs, Vegas lows, iconic roles, and the unforgettable people she met along the way. A lively, candid memoir from a legend.
Description_Famous_Last_Words: Camilla’s husband disappears, leaving a cryptic note. By noon, he’s the gunman in a London hostage siege. As police close in, she’s the only one who understands the message he left and the only person who can stop what comes next.
Description_Julie_Chan_Is_Dead: When Julie finds her influencer twin dead, she slips into her glamorous life. Designer wardrobe, perfect skin, millions of followers. But on an exclusive island retreat, she learns Chloe’s world was far from flawless. And someone wants the new “Chloe” gone too.
Description_Is_a_River_Alive: Robert Macfarlane travels from Ecuador’s cloud-forests to India’s wounded waterways and Canada’s wild rivers, asking a radical question: what if rivers are alive? A luminous blend of travel, nature writing, and urgent environmental insight.
Description_Empire_of_the_Vampire: With the sun vanished and vampires ascendant, Gabriel de León is humanity’s last silversaint and their last hope. Imprisoned by his enemies, he recounts battles, heartbreak, and the perilous chase for the Holy Grail.
Description_Once_Upon_a_River: A child revived from the dead sets a riverside community buzzing with theories. Miracle or trick of nature? As three families fight to claim her, their own secrets seep to the surface. The Thames carries truth, if anyone dares to follow it.
Description_Yellowface: June steals Athena’s novel and reinvents herself as a literary star, until the truth starts leaking through the cracks. A thrilling story of fame, fraud, and one very persistent ghost of a reputation.
Description_A_Wizard_of_Earthsea;_Earths: Sparrowhawk’s hunger for power unleashes a deadly shadow. To set things right, he must master true names, outwit a dragon, and walk beyond death itself. A legendary Earthsea journey of magic and balance.
Description_Blue_Sisters: After their sister’s death, three wildly different siblings return to New York to save their childhood home and face the truths they’ve long avoided. A moving, sharp story of grief, identity, and the ties that bind.
Description_Cleopatra_and_Frankenstein: A whirlwind marriage between a young painter and a wealthy older man reshapes the lives of everyone around them. Funny, messy, and moving, this novel explores love, identity, friendship, and the strange ways we grow up.
Description_Caturday_in_Bookstonbury;_Vo: In this visual photographic history of Bookstonbury, Luna Knight documents the local feline population. From majestic longhairs to playful shorthairs and everything in between, take a gander and learn more about these adorable floofs.
Description_A_Master_of_Djinn: In an alternate 1920s steampunk world where djinn magic has redefined Cairo society, witty and stylish Agent Fatma must investigate a supernatural murder with the help of her mysterious girlfriend, Siti.
Description_A_Night_in_the_Lonesome_Octo: Classic Victorian-era and folklore villains gather in the English countryside to partake in a strange game, each with their own animal familiar. Jack the Ripper's dog tells the story as he helps his master uncover the other players' mysterious machinations.
Description_Working_Songs_of_Bookstonbur: A collection of traditional shanties and sea songs by sailors and dockworkers around Bookstonbury harbour. Contains some old classics, as well as lesser-known local songs like The Net-Eating Shark and Even The Seagulls Like A Good Book.
Description_Madeline: Follow the adventures of 7-year-old Madeline in this illustrated children's book set in picturesque Paris. Spirited and brave in signature yellow, she navigates boarding school alongside her friends. A children’s classic, loved throughout time, with memorable rhymes.
Description_Merry_Mister_Meddle;_Mister_: A collection of humorous tales about Mister Meddle and his disastrous attempts at being helpful; like putting a 'growing-spell' in a wash-tub to help with laundry or mistaking glue for treacle that he uses to spruce up his aunt's pudding!
Description_A_Fish_Out_of_Water: There must be a reason why we've always been told to feed our pets just a little and "not too much". This classic picture book shows us exactly the reason when a young boy disobeys this golden rule, and his goldfish starts to grow... and grow... and grow, and GROW!
Description_Island_of_the_Blue_Dolphins: This timeless children's classic is based on the true story of a young Nicoleño girl stranded on an island for 18 years. Alone, Karana learns to survive the elements, and forges an unexpected bond with the wild animals she once feared and hunted.
Description_Tuesdays_with_Morrie: Over many meaningful conversations made during many Tuesday visits, the author reconnects with his dying college professor, Morrie. This short-but-moving memoir reflects on life's greatest questions.
Description_The_Girl_Who_Fell_Beneath_th: Inspired by a Korean folktale, this story follows Mina, a young girl who travels to the magical Spirit Realm and discovers the Sea God is in an enchanted sleep. With the help of the mysterious Shin, can Mina reawaken the slumbering god and save her village?
Description_The_Five_People_You_Meet_in_: After sacrificing his life to save a child in a tragic accident, old war veteran Eddie embarks on an afterlife journey where he meets the five people who shaped his life, and learns that his life was not as hollow and uninspired as he had once believed.
Description_The_Secret_Island;_The_Secre: A cosy tale of four children, Mike, Peggy, Nora and their friend Jack, who escape to a "secret" island on a serene lake, where they live an unfettered life of stowing away in a willow-treehouse and foraging for their own food.
Description_I_See_You: Zoe's photo is in the paper. A mistake, or perhaps a message? Consumed by paranoia, she and Detective Kelly race to uncover the truth. Someone is watching... Waiting... And danger seems to lurk in every corner.
Description_The_Toymakers: The Emporium is where Papa Jack and his two sons craft and sell magical toys for children every winter's frost. Set in 1940s London, Cathy, young and homeless, is welcomed into the fold of the toyshop, where she learns to understand the magic of childhood imagination.
Description_The_Night_Circus: A tale of the competition between two young magicians, where they duel using the breathtaking wonders of a magical circus they create together. Though only one can be left standing by the end, Celia and Marco are magnetically drawn together in a tragic love.
Description_William: In his high-tech home, Henry, a brilliant engineer, has created an artificially intelligent consciousness —William. However, William goes rogue when some guests visit, leading to a cat-and-mouse game of survival where the house itself becomes the danger.
Description_Heartless: Not all fairytales have a happy ending. The Queen of Hearts is a brutal monarch. But once, she was just Catherine—young and idealistic. Shenanigans ensue when Cath meets Jest, sparking a forbidden love story where hearts are stolen, broken and freely given...
Description_The_Sunlit_Man: Nomad has been jumping between different worlds to stay ahead of his pursuers. But with his diminished powers, he is trapped on a planet where the sun's intensity will kill, and finds himself caught up in a struggle between a despotic ruler and the defiant rebels.
Description_The_Chalk_Man: In 1986, Eddie and his friends used chalk figures as a secret code—until it led them to a body. Now in 2016, these menacing figures have returned, and another murder ensues. Eddie must return to the past to uncover seething secrets and unearth the killer's identity.
Description_The_Taking_of_Annie_Thorne: Joe Thorne has never gotten over his sister's disappearance and her unsettling return. As Stephen King says (and surely Joe would agree), “sometimes, dead is better". Now he's home, back where it all went wrong, seeking answers and revenge as he confronts the past.
Description_Don't_Be_Silly,_Mr_Twiddle!;: Mr Twiddle is a kind and honest fellow but he is often forgetful, lazy and very, very, VERY silly! This is a collection of his hilarious misadventures, and the many muddles he gets himself—and poor Mrs Twiddle—into.
Description_Yumi_and_the_Nightmare_Paint: Yumi, hailing from a life of spirituality, and Painter, who lives in darkness, technology and nightmares, find themselves interchanging lives periodically. To uncover this mystery—and stop an impending disaster—they must work together and learn to understand each other.
Description_Deadly_Diseases;Horrible_Sci: Filled with sick jokes, sickening stories and seriously sick facts, discover all the dreadful details of deadly diseases that mankind has suffered through!
Description_Disgusting_Digestion;Horribl: Get ready for a new dose of Horrible Science! Pack your lunchboxes for we're going on a journey through your stinky, smelly, and gooey digestive system to uncover foul secrets you'd never learn in class.
Description_Nasty_Nature;Horrible_Scienc: All about the nastiest things nature has to offer! From freaky deep-sea creatures to pesky sky-borne parasites, you're bound to become a true naturalist by the final page.
Description_The_Secret_History: Richard reminisces his time at an elitist college, in his throes of unrequited obsession for a clique of unabashed intellectuals and ditzy decadents. He yearns to befriend them, sleep with them, become them—including, as they indulge in ever-spiraling hedonism, murder.
Description_Life_of_Pi: Imagine young Robinson Crusoe, but his island is a solitary lifeboat teeming with wild animals—including a huge Bengal tiger. Pi's journey is one marked by persistent uncertainty and fantastical encounters, where survival is intertwined with sublime wonder and faith.
Description_Chemical_Chaos;Horrible_Scie: Chemistry is confusing, and chemistry lessons are boring. Fret not! For this book is not about the bits you learn in school—but the funny bits, the fascinating bits and the bits that end up in blasts and bangs and dodgy discoveries!
Description_Insurgent;Divergent_#2: As war looms over the five fractured factions, Tris must now embrace her Divergence and choose a side in a conflict where every choice comes with a devastating cost. Book two of the dystopian trilogy Divergent.
Description_Allegiant;Divergent_#3: As the Factionless seize power, a new civil war threatens to destroy what remains of the shattered faction society. Tris, Four, and a handful of allies must venture beyond the barriers to save their city from self-destruction. How is the war going to end? And when?
Description_Star_Wars:_Lost_Stars: Thane Kyrell and Ciena Ree are childhood friends-turned-lovers with different upbringings. When a disillusioned Thane defects to the Rebellion, Ciena is forced to choose between an Empire undeserving of her loyalty and the man she loves in a galaxy-wide war.
Description_Eileen: Set in the early 60s, this book chronicles Eileen's budding friendship with the charismatic Rebecca Saint John—and the obsessive affection that pulls her complicit into a crime. A character-driven tale for lovers of unreliable narrators and a dash of dark humour.
Description_A_Little_Hope: A collection of short stories about different intertwined characters in a small town. Each story is filled with heartbreak, grief and love as the characters battle with the past, try to manage the present and worry about their future.
Description_On_Earth_We're_Briefly_Gorge: A novel written in the form of a letter, addressed from a son to his illiterate mother; a recipient who, like a ghost, is not promised—only longed for. Redolent of queer and feminist thinking, this is a raw and earnest exploration of race, class, and honesty.
Description_The_Giver;(Book_1): Jonas lives in a perfectly perfect world. But when he is chosen as the Receiver—the sole keeper of humanity's suppressed memories from long since past—he uncovers the startling realities upon which his society is built.
Description_Gathering_Blue;(The_Giver,_B: Set in a post-apocalyptic world where the 'undesirable' are cast out, orphaned and disabled Kira is spared for her magical embroidery. Forced to work for the village, she begins unraveling the dark truths hidden beneath its innocent facade.
Description_Messenger;(The_Giver,_Book_3: In a Village now consumed by avarice and fear, and a Forest that has turned lethal, Matty the Messenger boy must make a final, dangerous journey. The acclaimed Giver quartet continues with another poignant dystopian parable.
Description_How_to_Train_a_Superdog: Unlock secrets to your dog's mind! This handy-dandy little book, complete with a training program and helpful illustrations, will guide you to unleashing your pet's true potential and raising them to be the best-est of best pooch!
Description_Conversations_with_Friends: This novel follows Frances as she navigates the complex relationships with her best friend and ex-girlfriend, Bobbi, and an older married couple, Nick and Melissa. A piercing exploration of blurred boundaries of intimacy and the struggles of one's identity.
Description_Son;(The_Giver,_Book_4): A spellbinding conclusion to the Giver quartet, this story follows Claire, who is assigned the role of a Vessel—a birthmother tasked with carrying a Product to term. A tale of a mother who will stop at nothing to find and reconnect with the son taken from her.
Description_Terrifying_Tudors;Horrible_H: History can be horrible, and it was the vicious people of the past who made it that way. Fascinatingly, some of these terrible people all had names beginning with 'T'... Like the teachers—I mean, the Tudors!
Description_Barmy_British_Empire;Horribl: History of the British Empire is full of horrible people and horrible deeds. Find out how a war started when a Brit was sitting on a stool and who wore a necklace made of human skulls in this not-so-horribly-boring history book!
Description_Villainous_Victorians;Horrib: Teachers may tell you Victoria's Britain was an exciting place, but it was also a time of cruelty and wickedness. Read on for all the vile facts about the villainous Victorians, peppered with horribly hilarious humour that will keep you turning pages!
Description_Will_You_Love_Me?;The_story_: In this two-part fostering memoir, Cathy Glass shares the story of Lucy's journey, told from the perspectives of both her birth mother and foster mother, revealing how their lives became intertwined.
Description_Saving_Danny: One of Cathy Glass's many fostering memoirs, this is the story of Danny, who comes into her care when his parents can no longer cope with his learning difficulties. It's a powerful testament to how a little love and patience can change a child's life.
Description_Steelheart;The_Reckoners_#1: Absolute power corrupts absolutely, and in a world where superpowers create inhuman despots, David seeks revenge on the strongest of them all: Steelheart—the one deemed invincible, but the one he's seen bleed. Get ready for an action-packed sci-fi adventure!
Description_The_Girl_who_Rowed_the_Ocean: Lucy wants to go on a real adventure, so she rows across the Atlantic! Along the way, she faces storms, seasickness, and gigantic sea creatures, but also magical sunsets, dolphins, and shooting stars. A tale for little dreamers who long to see the wonders of the world.
Description_Journey_into_the_Mind's_Eye;: A collection of anecdotes chronicling a woman's journey to Siberia to find a lover from her youth—the man who once enchanted her with Russian fairytales. An ode to pre-revolutionary Russia and the author's metaphorical seduction by old, vanished Russia.
Description_The_Sea_Inside: A collection of anecdotes, histories, and mythologies from Philip's seemingly aimless wanderings across the world—each one, in its own way, connected to the sea, its islands, and its maritime creatures.
Description_British_Boutique_Hotels: From quiet country retreats to luxurious city stays, this pocket-sized guide is your key to Britain's best boutique hotels! A highly opinionated and indispensable companion for the discerning traveler.
Description_The_Wilder_Shores_of_Love: An engaging account of four women from the nineteenth century who threw off their corsets and escaped their boring, conventional lives to find love and adventure on the wilder shores of the Middle East.
Description_Coffee_First,_Then_the_World: We've all been on a bike, maybe even done a few long-distance ride. But Jenny Graham took it much further: she cycled around the world! This is her raw, unfiltered, and hilarious account of how she became the fastest woman to ever circumnavigate the globe on two wheels.
Description_A_Florence_Diary: A charming diary, chronicling Athill's fortnight in Italy, 1947. Illustrated with delightful black and white photos of Florence, this little book captures an era of travel that has been lost to time.
Description_The_Boundless_Sea;A_Human_Hi: In this dauntingly comprehensive volume, explore humankind's relationship with the planet's greatest body of water—the ocean. This definitive work chronicles the world history of maritime empires and trade routes, while debunking long-held myths and beliefs.
Description_the_sun_and_her_flowers: A collection of poetry that takes us on a transcendent journey through five chapters of love, growth, and healing while weaving in the shared experiences of immigration and the refugee passage.
Description_Edinburgh;_Picturesque_Notes: A travelogue told in a series of anecdotes with whimsical exaggerations that captures the author's view of his hometown circa late 1870s, in all its glories and infamies.
Description_The_Nutmeg_Trail;A_Culinary_: From the spice route map to its magical flavour profiles, from the culinary history to its recipes, this is a book to inhale, to savour, and to return to again and again!
Description_The_Garden_of_Evening_Mists: Set in post-war Malaya, this story follows Yun Ling, a war-crime survivor and retired judge, through a shifting timeline between the 1980s and flashbacks to 1949, as she seeks solace in the lush highlands of her childhood.
Description_A_Man_Called_Ove: Featuring Ove, the quintessential curmudgeon and a ragtag cast of characters, this is the tale of how healing can occur with the unlikeliest of people, in the unlikeliest of ways.
Description_A_Monster_Calls: Conor is haunted by monsters—his mother's illness, his father's absence, school bullies, and teachers' pity. Then, one night, a real monster visits. And it has come for one purpose: to tell Conor three stories in exchange for the truth.
Description_The_Lost_Words;A_Spell_Book: Gone are the days when children’s alphabets began with A for Acorn, B for Butterfly and C for Caterpillar. But in this book of spellbinding poetry and enchanting illustrations, the magical words of nature, travel, and animals are restored into our lives.
Description_A_Tomb_with_a_View;The_Stori: Uncovering the histories of those lying in a place where time stands still, Peter Ross pays homage to the famous, the infamous, and the forgotten in graveyards across Britain and Ireland. A book for all the taphophiles out there!
Description_A_Buzz_in_the_Meadows;The_Na: A tale of how Goulson transformed a derelict farm into a sanctuary for plants and pollinators. Filled with humorous anecdotes and fascinating science, this book is a heartfelt plea to cherish and protect life in all its forms—especially the tiniest of creatures.
Description_Letters_from_Egypt;1862-1869: After her diagnosis of tuberculosis, Lady Gordon travels to Egypt in hopes of improving her dwindling health. A compilation of her letters, detailing her account of life in Luxor, this is the story of an Englishwoman's immersion into Egyptian culture.
Description_I_Am_Number_Four;Lorien_Lega: Four is one of nine survivors from a race of super-powered aliens hiding on Earth. He doesn't know where the others are, only that they are being hunted by their enemies in numerical order. The first three are gone. Four is next.
Description_The_Journey;Big_Panda_and_Ti: The adventures of Big Panda and Tiny Dragon continue as they navigate some of life's trying moments. Accompanied by charming illustrations, this is a beautiful picture book about friendship and overcoming adversity.
Description_Provence_to_Pondicherry;Reci: Starting in Provence and following the routes of early French explorers, Kiros takes us on a journey to discover French culinary influences in far-flung colonial destinations through an array of delicious recipes.
Description_A_Dragon_Apparent;Travels_in: In the final decade before war would sweep all he witnessed into history, Lewis travels through Vietnam, Laos and Cambodia to see the curtain start to fall on an era of French colonial rule.
Description_My_Tiny_Atlas;Our_World_Thro: A collection of photographs of picturesque wonders from all around the globe. The perfect companion for the avid traveler or the armchair dreamer with a serious case of wanderlust!
Description_The_Ginger_Tree: Set in the early 1900s, we follow Mary as she sails across the world to marry a man she barely knows. But when a forbidden love affair costs her everything, she must forge a completely new life from scratch.
Description_Round_the_World_in_Eighty_Di: A rich collection of dishes from around the world, each accompanied by its own travel anecdote that opens a fascinating window into a time long past.
Description_Pictures_from_Italy: Did you know Charles Dickens wrote travelogues? A vivid account of his sojourn in Italy, with a thrilling blend of personal excitement and piercing social commentary on a land that both charmed and provoked him.
Description_Shearwater;A_Bird,_an_Ocean,: Intertwining memoir, nature writing, and travelogue, this book chronicles the author's year-long adventure in pursuit of the longstanding object of his fascination: the impressive seabird known as the Manx shearwater, or Puffinus puffinus!
Description_Travel_Light,_Move_Fast: Told through a series of juxtaposed vignettes from her past, this memoir by Alexandra pieces together the portrait of a fascinating, roughly-hewn, and ultimately tragic family and their misadventures of in southern and central Africa.
Description_An_Atlas_of_Countries_that_D: From vast regions like Catalonia to tiny islands claimed by a single person, this book tours 50 unrecognised and largely unnoticed 'countries'—by turns hilarious, heartbreaking, and fascinating. The perfect bunny-slipper read for the armchair traveler.
Description_A_Voyage_for_Madmen: Nine men. One race to sail across the world. One to win the prestige, glamour and trophy; the rest to fall to madness, failure, and death. The thrilling accounts from the contestants of the Golden Globe race of 1968.
Description_Skyward;(Book_1): Humanity is trapped on a planet under attack by mysterious aliens. Spensa, living among them, dreams of joining the pilots defending humanity. Join her, as she fights for a place in flight school and faces the harsh reality of war.
Description_Starsight;(Skyward,_Book_2): In this sequel to Skyward, Spensa, ace pilot, now has more questions left unanswered. Why do the aliens keep attacking humanity? Why could she hear the stars scream? With nothing but a bold plan, Spensa risks it all to discover the truth, or die trying.
Description_The_Bright_Sword: The adventure of Collum and the oddballs of the Round Table as they seek to restore order to the kingdom after the death of King Arthur and the heroes of legend. Together, they will learn the troubled past of King Arthur and mysteries of Britain.
Description_The_Invisible_Life_of_Addie_: Addie Larue once made a deal with the devil. Now she wanders the world as a ghost, forgotten by everyone she meets. Follow Addie's journey to find meaning to her existence as she learns to leave her mark on the world, and discovers a man who can remember her name.
Description_The_Saviour_Fish;Life_and_De: A captivating blend of travel writing and environmental reportage, this erudite work chronicles the author's life on remote Ukerewe Island in Lake Victoria, offering a profound perspective on ecological and cultural upheaval.
Description_A_Darker_Shade_of_Magic;Shad: Set in multiple Londons (yes, you read that right!), with cross-dressing thieves, aspiring pirates, and sadistic kings, prepare yourself for a thrilling trilogy brimming with magic, lots of magic, more magic... and angst!
Description_Hunting_Mister_Heartbreak;A_: A travelogue; a social history; a love letter to the United States. Written in the wondrous, wry prose of an adventurer and a scholar, this work offers an outsider's keen eye on America's inconsistencies, foibles, and grandeur.
Description_The_Time_Keeper: A story of slowing down and treasuring every moment, where Father Time comes to our world, one consumed by counting every second and minute, to teach two individuals about the gift of life and the beauty of its conclusion.
Description_Foundryside;The_Founders_Tri: Sancia Grado is a good thief with some...unique abilities. In her latest heist, Sancia unknowingly steals an ancient artifact that could shake the foundations of the universe. In the city of Tevanne, the Merchant Houses are king. And now, they hunt Sancia.
Description_Ashfall_Legacy;Ashfall_#1: Syd Chambers, alien-human hybrid, has never known his father, a Denza native who disappeared years ago. Picking up the trail, Syd now journeys beyond Earth to seek out his father, discovering a universe-shattering secret along the way.
Description_The_Rhythm_of_the_Rain: With a gentle tip of his jar, a boy sends droplets of water on a long journey downstream. This gorgeous picture book follows that journey, gently tracing the path of the water cycle.
Description_The_Door-to-Door_Bookstore: A tender story of an old bookseller, who delivers personalised selections to his customers, and the unlikely friendship with a little girl that changes his life forever... A book about books, for every book lovers and bibliophiles out there.
Description_Supernova;Renegades_#3: The Renegades' greatest enemy is alive, a danger once more to Gatlon City. In this thrilling conclusion to the Renegades, Adrian and Nova struggle to protect those they love, all while keeping secrets from one another. When the dust settles, who will be left standing?
